11. REST aur REST API design

10 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Pichle topic (Spring MVC request flow) mein humne dekha ki request Tomcat se DispatcherServlet tak aati hai, HandlerMapping sahi controller method dhoondhta hai aur Jackson JSON banata hai. Machine to ready hai. Ab sawaal ye hai: URLs, methods, status codes kaise design karein taaki API saaf, predictable aur professional ho? Yahi REST hai.
📖 Notes

Pehle: API kya hota hai?

API (Application Programming Interface) = do software ke beech ka contract. Ek side bolta hai 'mujhe ye chahiye', doosra side batata hai 'is format mein maango, is format mein milega'.

Restaurant socho: tum (client) kitchen (server/DB) mein nahi ghuste. Waiter + menu (API) ke through order dete ho. Menu batata hai kya mil sakta hai, waiter request le jaata hai aur plate (response) laata hai. Kitchen ka andar ka kaam tumhe pata hona zaroori nahi.

Real exampleAndroid app (RMS) login button dabata hai → POST /api/v1/auth/login → Spring Boot server JSON mein token lautata hai. Yahi API hai. Same backend ko web app, mobile app aur doosre services sab use kar sakte hain.

Problem: bina rules ke API

Teen developer, teen style: ek ne GET /getAllStudents banaya, doosre ne POST /student/fetch, teesre ne GET /deleteStudent?id=5. Har error pe 200 {"success":false}. Frontend wala har endpoint ka docs padhta hai, cache/retry kuch kaam nahi karta, aur GET /deleteStudent ko koi crawler hit kare to data udd jaaye! Chahiye ek common style.

Bina rules:                       REST ke saath:
GET  /getAllStudents             GET    /api/v1/students
POST /student/fetch {id:5}       GET    /api/v1/students/5
POST /saveStudent                POST   /api/v1/students
POST /updateStudentEmail         PATCH  /api/v1/students/5
GET  /deleteStudent?id=5         DELETE /api/v1/students/5

Solution: REST kya hai

REST = Representational State Transfer (Roy Fielding, 2000). Ye architectural style hai, koi library ya protocol nahi. HTTP ko uske asli tareeke se use karna.

Teen shabd pakdo: Resource (cheez: student, order) → URI (uska address: /students/5) → Representation (uska JSON roop). Action batata hai HTTP method, result batata hai status code. Q57

REST conceptMatlabExample
ResourceNoun / cheezStudent
URIResource ka address/api/v1/students/5
RepresentationData ka formatJSON { "id":5, "name":"Ram" }
MethodKya karna haiGET / POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE
Status codeKya hua200, 201, 404 ...

REST ke 6 constraints (rules)

  • Client-Server: frontend aur backend alag; dono alag deploy/evolve hon.
  • Stateless: server client ka session yaad nahi rakhta; har request mein token (JWT) aata hai. Isi se 10 instances ke peeche load balancer laga sakte ho.
  • Cacheable: response bataye cache ho sakta hai ya nahi (Cache-Control, ETag).
  • Uniform Interface: har resource pe same rules: URI se identify, representation se badlo, self-descriptive messages (Content-Type), HATEOAS links.
  • Layered System: client ko pata nahi beech mein gateway / load balancer / CDN hai.
  • Code on Demand (optional): server JS bhej sakta hai; rarely used.
Yaad rakhoStateless ≠ 'DB nahi'. Data DB mein hai; sirf session state server memory mein nahi. Q59

REST vs SOAP (short mein)

REST API vs RESTful: HTTP + JSON wali har API 'REST API' kehlati hai, par RESTful tab hai jab constraints follow kare: noun URLs, sahi methods, sahi status, stateless. Q58

RESTSOAP
TypeArchitectural styleProtocol (W3C standard)
FormatJSON (mostly), XML bhiSirf XML (envelope)
TransportHTTPHTTP, SMTP, ...
ContractOpenAPI (optional)WSDL (strict)
WeightHalka, fastBhaari, verbose
KahanWeb/mobile/microservicesPurane banking/enterprise systems, WS-Security

Resource naming rules

Q60

  • Nouns, verbs nahi: /students, na ki /getStudents (verb = HTTP method)
  • Plural: /students, /students/42
  • Nesting sirf ownership ke liye, max 1-2 level: /students/42/courses
  • kebab-case, lowercase: /order-items
  • No .json extension, no trailing slash
  • Filter/sort/page query params mein: /students?city=Delhi&sort=name,asc
  • Version prefix: /api/v1/...
/api/v1/students                 -> collection
/api/v1/students/42              -> ek student
/api/v1/students/42/courses      -> student 42 ke courses
/api/v1/order-items?orderId=7    -> filter

HTTP methods → CRUD

Safe = server state nahi badalta (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS). Idempotent = 1 baar ya 10 baar, server state same (lift ka button). Isliye timeout pe GET/PUT/DELETE retry safe hai, POST nahi. Q61

MethodURLKaamSafeIdempotentSuccess
GET/studentsListHaanHaan200
GET/students/42Ek padhoHaanHaan200
POST/studentsNaya banaoNahiNahi201 + Location
PUT/students/42Poora replaceNahiHaan200/204
PATCH/students/42Kuch fieldsNahiGuaranteed nahi200
DELETE/students/42HataoNahiHaan204

PUT vs PATCH vs POST

Existing: { "id":42, "name":"Ram", "email":"ram@mail.com", "city":"Delhi" }

PUT   /students/42  { "name":"Ram Kumar", "email":"ram@mail.com" }
  ->  { "id":42, "name":"Ram Kumar", "email":"ram@mail.com", "city":null }   // poora replace
PATCH /students/42  { "city":"Pune" }
  ->  { "id":42, "name":"Ram", "email":"ram@mail.com", "city":"Pune" }      // sirf city
POST  /students     { "name":"Shyam", ... }  -> 201, naya id 43 (dobara bhejo = id 44!)
Common galtiPUT likh ke usme null fields ignore karna = asal mein PATCH. Behaviour docs mein clear rakho. Q62

Status codes: har operation ka sahi jawab

CodeKabExample
200 OKSuccess + bodyGET, PUT, PATCH
201 CreatedNaya bana + Location headerPOST /students
204 No ContentSuccess, body nahiDELETE
400 Bad RequestGalat/invalid inputemail missing
401 UnauthorizedLogin nahi / token invalidJWT missing
403 ForbiddenLogin hai, permission nahiUSER delete kar raha
404 Not FoundResource nahi mila/students/999
409 ConflictState clashDuplicate email, version mismatch
422 UnprocessableFormat sahi, business rule failStock se zyada order
500 Internal ErrorUnexpected bugNullPointerException
Dhyan doEmpty list = 200 [], 404 nahi. 404 tab jab specific resource (/students/999) na mile. Status families: Q76. Q63

Headers: Content-Type aur Accept

  • Content-Type: jo body main bhej raha hoon uska format (application/json). Galat ho to 415 Unsupported Media Type.
  • Accept: mujhe response kis format mein chahiye. Server de nahi sakta to 406 Not Acceptable.
  • Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
  • Location: 201 ke saath naye resource ka URL
  • ETag / If-None-Match: caching, 304 Not Modified
  • X-Request-Id: tracing ke liye
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/students \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..." \
  -d '{"name":"Ram","email":"ram@mail.com"}'

Filtering, sorting, pagination

  • Path saaf, options query mein
  • size ki max limit (jaise 100)
  • Sort fields whitelist
  • Bahut bada / live data: cursor (?after=lastId) paging
  • Spring mein Pageable seedha bind hota hai (next topic) Q65
GET /api/v1/students?city=Delhi&status=ACTIVE&page=0&size=20&sort=name,asc

{ "content": [ ... 20 items ... ],
  "page": 0, "size": 20, "totalElements": 134, "totalPages": 7 }

Versioning

Naya optional field add karna breaking nahi; field hatana/rename karna, type badalna breaking hai → v2. Purani version ko kuch time chalao (deprecation). Q64

TareekaExampleKab
URI/api/v1/studentsDefault choice, sabse common
HeaderX-API-Version: 2Clean URL chahiye
Media typeAccept: application/vnd.rms.v2+jsonStrict REST
Query param?version=2Quick, kam use

HATEOAS aur Idempotency key

HATEOAS theory mein REST ka hissa hai, practically kam APIs use karti hain. Idempotency key payments/orders mein bahut kaam ki: mobile network toota, app ne retry kiya, double charge nahi hoga. Q66

// HATEOAS response (Spring HATEOAS)
{ "id": 7, "status": "PLACED",
  "_links": { "self": { "href": "/api/v1/orders/7" },
              "cancel": { "href": "/api/v1/orders/7/cancellation" } } }

// Idempotency key: POST ko retry-safe banana
POST /api/v1/payments
Idempotency-Key: 6f1c2a9e-4b1d-...   -> same key dobara = same response, payment ek hi baar

Consistent error format

Har error ek hi shape mein aaye taaki frontend ek hi parser likhe. Spring 6 ka ProblemDetail (RFC 9457) bhi use kar sakte ho.

404 Not Found
{ "timestamp": "2026-10-14T10:15:30Z", "status": 404, "error": "Not Found",
  "message": "Student 999 not found", "path": "/api/v1/students/999" }
Yaad rakhoController mein try-catch nahi; global handler. Poora setup Exception handling topic mein: Q77, Q79, Q80, Q81.

API design checklist

  • Nouns, plural, kebab-case, /api/v1
  • Sahi method + sahi status (201+Location, 204, 404, 409)
  • DTO in/out, entity kabhi nahi
  • @Valid + 400 with field errors
  • Ek error format
  • Pagination with max size; filter/sort query mein
  • JWT auth, HTTPS, rate limit (429)
  • Side-effect POST pe idempotency key
  • OpenAPI docs
  • Breaking change = new version
📌 Yaad rakho
  • REST = style; resource + URI + representation + HTTP method + status code
  • URL mein noun aur plural; verb ka kaam method karta hai
  • GET/PUT/DELETE idempotent, POST nahi; GET safe
  • PUT = poora replace, PATCH = partial, POST = create (201 + Location)
  • Stateless: har request mein token, server pe session nahi
  • Filter/sort/page query params mein; size cap karo
  • Versioning: default /api/v1; breaking change pe hi bump

✅ Review questions (10): ab khud check karo

Q57

What is REST? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • REST (Representational State Transfer) is an architectural style for building web services, defined by Roy Fielding (2000).
  • Everything is a resource identified by a URI, clients work with representations of it (usually JSON) using standard HTTP methods, and every request is stateless.
  • It is not a protocol or a library; it is a set of constraints over HTTP.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • REST कोई library या protocol नहीं, एक design style है।
  • हर चीज़ एक resource है जिसका अपना URL होता है, और हम उस पर GET, POST, PUT, DELETE जैसे HTTP methods चलाते हैं।
  • जैसे library में हर book का एक fixed shelf number होता है, वैसे ही हर resource का एक URL होता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Naam ka matlab

Representational: server resource ka ek representation (JSON) bhejta hai, actual DB row nahi. State Transfer: client us representation ke through resource ki state padhta/badalta hai (PUT se nayi state bhejta hai).

  • Resource = noun (student, order), URI se pehchana jaata hai
  • Representation = resource ka JSON/XML roop
  • HTTP methods = action (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE)
  • Stateless = har request apne aap mein complete
  • Style hai, standard nahi
GET /api/v1/students/42      -> resource ko padho
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{ "id": 42, "name": "Ram", "email": "ram@mail.com" }
Important 19 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q53)★ Important listAgla important (Q60) → ★
Q58

What is a REST API and what makes it RESTful?

Main Definition

  • A REST API is any HTTP API that exposes resources over URLs and uses JSON.
  • It is truly RESTful only when it follows the REST constraints: resource-based URIs, correct use of HTTP methods and status codes, statelessness, cacheability and a uniform interface.
  • An API like POST /getStudent or GET /deleteUser?id=5 uses HTTP but is not RESTful.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • API मतलब दो software के बीच का contract, जैसे restaurant का menu।
  • REST API वो है जो HTTP और JSON use करती है, लेकिन RESTful तभी कहलाती है जब URL में nouns हों, सही HTTP method और सही status code use हो।
  • POST /getStudent चलती तो है पर RESTful नहीं है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Non-RESTfulRESTful
POST /getStudentGET /students/{id}
GET /deleteUser?id=5DELETE /users/5
POST /createOrderPOST /orders
Har response 200 + {"error":...}Sahi status: 201, 404, 409 ...
Yaad rakhoReal duniya mein zyada APIs 'REST-like' hoti hain (HATEOAS ke bina). Practically 'RESTful' ka matlab: resource URLs + sahi methods + sahi status codes + stateless.
Q59

What are the REST constraints?

Main Definition

  • Fielding defined six constraints: Client-Server (UI and data storage separated), Stateless (each request carries all needed info, e.g. a JWT; no server session), Cacheable (responses say whether they can be cached), Uniform Interface (resource URIs, manipulation via representations, self-descriptive messages, HATEOAS), Layered System (client can't tell if it talks to a gateway, load balancer or the real server) and optional Code on Demand.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • REST के 6 rules हैं: client-server, stateless, cacheable, uniform interface, layered system और optional code on demand।
  • सबसे ज़रूरी stateless है: server पिछली request याद नहीं रखता, हर request में token खुद भेजना पड़ता है।
  • जैसे toll booth हर गाड़ी से हर बार ticket देखता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
ConstraintMatlabSpring Boot mein
Client-ServerFrontend aur backend alag evolve kareinReact/Android app + Boot API
StatelessServer pe session nahiJWT har request mein, SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS
CacheableResponse bataye cache ho sakta ya nahiCache-Control, ETag headers
Uniform InterfaceSame rules har resource peNouns URLs, HTTP verbs, status codes
Layered SystemBeech mein layers ho sakti hainGateway, load balancer, CDN
Code on Demand (optional)Server code (JS) bhej sakta haiRarely used
Dhyan doStateless ka matlab 'DB nahi' nahi hai. Data DB mein rehta hai; sirf client ki session state server memory mein nahi rehni chahiye. Isi se horizontal scaling easy hoti hai: koi bhi instance koi bhi request le sakta hai.
Q60

How do you name REST resources and URLs? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • Use nouns, not verbs (the HTTP method is the verb), plural collection names (/students), an id for a single item (/students/42), nesting only for real ownership and at most one or two levels (/students/42/courses), lowercase kebab-case (/order-items), no file extensions and no trailing slash.
  • Filtering, sorting and paging go in query parameters, not in the path.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • URL में noun रखो, verb नहीं, क्योंकि verb का काम HTTP method करता है।
  • Collection का नाम plural रखो जैसे /students, और एक item के लिए /students/42।
  • Words को kebab-case में लिखो और filter या sort query params में भेजो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
RuleGalatSahi
Noun, verb nahi/getAllStudentsGET /students
Plural/student/42/students/42
Kebab-case lowercase/orderItems, /Order_Items/order-items
Nesting (ownership)/courses?studentId=42 (relation ke liye ok bhi)/students/42/courses
Zyada deep nahi/schools/1/classes/2/students/3/marks/4/marks/4
Filter query mein/students/active/city/delhi/students?status=active&city=delhi
Version prefix/students (breaking change pe dikkat)/api/v1/students
Dhyan doJo action CRUD mein fit nahi hota (jaise 'cancel order'), use sub-resource ya state change ki tarah model karo: POST /orders/7/cancellation ya PATCH /orders/7 {"status":"CANCELLED"}. Pragmatic POST /orders/7/cancel bhi chalta hai, par isse exception rakho, rule nahi.
Important 20 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q57)★ Important listAgla important (Q61) → ★
Q61

Which HTTP method is used for which operation, and which methods are safe and idempotent? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • GET reads, POST creates (or triggers a process), PUT replaces a whole resource, PATCH partially updates, DELETE removes.
  • A safe method doesn't change server state (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS).
  • An idempotent method gives the same server state no matter how many times it is repeated (GET, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS).
  • POST is neither, and PATCH is not guaranteed idempotent.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • GET पढ़ने के लिए, POST नया बनाने के लिए, PUT पूरा replace करने के लिए, PATCH थोड़ा update करने के लिए और DELETE हटाने के लिए।
  • Idempotent मतलब एक बार करो या दस बार, result same, जैसे lift का button बार-बार दबाना।
  • POST idempotent नहीं है, दो बार भेजा तो दो order बन सकते हैं।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
MethodCRUDSafeIdempotentBody
GETReadHaanHaanNahi
POSTCreateNahiNahiHaan
PUTUpdate (replace)NahiHaanHaan
PATCHUpdate (partial)NahiGuaranteed nahiHaan
DELETEDeleteNahiHaanUsually nahi
HEAD / OPTIONSMeta / CORS preflightHaanHaanNahi
Idempotent ka practical fayda

Network timeout pe client/gateway safely retry kar sakta hai sirf idempotent calls ko. DELETE dobara chalao: pehli baar 204, doosri baar 404, par server state same (resource gone). Isliye wo idempotent hai, response code alag hone ke bawajood.

Important 21 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q60)★ Important listAgla important (Q62) → ★
Q62

What is the difference between PUT, PATCH and POST? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • POST /students creates a new resource; the server picks the id and repeating it creates duplicates.
  • PUT /students/42 replaces the full resource with the body sent (missing fields become null/default); it is idempotent.
  • PATCH /students/42 sends only the fields to change; other fields stay as they are.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • POST नया resource बनाता है और id server देता है।
  • PUT पूरा object replace करता है, जो field नहीं भेजी वो null हो सकती है।
  • PATCH सिर्फ़ वो fields बदलता है जो भेजी गई, जैसे form में सिर्फ़ phone number edit करना।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
POSTPUTPATCH
URLCollection /studentsItem /students/42Item /students/42
BodyNaya objectPoora objectSirf changed fields
IdempotentNahiHaanUsually nahi
Success code201 + Location200 (body) / 204200 / 204
// Existing: { "id":42, "name":"Ram", "email":"ram@mail.com", "city":"Delhi" }

PUT /students/42   { "name":"Ram Kumar", "email":"ram@mail.com" }
// Result:        { "id":42, "name":"Ram Kumar", "email":"ram@mail.com", "city":null }  <- city gaya!

PATCH /students/42 { "city":"Pune" }
// Result:        { "id":42, "name":"Ram", "email":"ram@mail.com", "city":"Pune" }
Common galtiPUT endpoint banake usme 'null field ignore karo' logic likhna = wo asal mein PATCH hai. Dono ka behaviour clear rakho aur docs mein likho.
Important 22 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q61)★ Important listAgla important (Q63) → ★
Q63

Which status codes should each REST endpoint return? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • Use the status code to tell the outcome: 200 OK for successful GET/PUT/PATCH with a body, 201 Created plus a Location header for POST, 204 No Content for DELETE (or update without body).
  • Client errors: 400 bad/invalid input, 401 not authenticated, 403 authenticated but not allowed, 404 not found, 409 conflict (duplicate email, version clash), 422 semantically invalid.
  • 500 only for unexpected server bugs.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Status code client को बताता है कि क्या हुआ, body पढ़ने से पहले ही।
  • POST पर 201 और Location header, DELETE पर 204, record न मिले तो 404, duplicate पर 409।
  • 401 मतलब login नहीं किया, 403 मतलब login है पर permission नहीं।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
OperationSuccessCommon errors
GET /students200 (empty list bhi 200, 404 nahi)400 (bad query param)
GET /students/42200404
POST /students201 + Location400 validation, 409 duplicate
PUT /students/42200 / 204400, 404, 409
PATCH /students/42200400, 404, 422
DELETE /students/42204404 (ya 204 agar already gone)
Koi bhi-401, 403, 429 too many requests, 500
Common galtiHar cheez pe 200 {"success":false} bhejna. Monitoring, gateways, retries sab status code dekhte hain. Status families aur professional response ke liye Q75 aur Q76 dekho.
Important 23 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q62)★ Important listAgla important (Q67) → ★
Q64

How do you version a REST API?

Main Definition

  • Versioning lets you make breaking changes without breaking existing clients.
  • Common strategies: URI versioning (/api/v1/students, most common and visible), request parameter (?version=1), custom header (X-API-Version: 1) and media type / content negotiation (Accept: application/vnd.rms.v1+json).
  • Only bump the major version for breaking changes; adding optional fields is not breaking.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Versioning इसलिए ताकि नया change आए तो पुराने mobile app ना टूटें।
  • सबसे आसान और common तरीका URL में /v1, /v2 डालना है।
  • Header या media type से भी कर सकते हैं, पर उसे browser में test करना मुश्किल है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
StrategyExamplePlusMinus
URI/api/v1/studentsSimple, visible, cache-friendlyURL badalta hai
Query param/students?version=2EasyOptional param bhool sakte ho
HeaderX-API-Version: 2Clean URLBrowser/curl mein chhupa
Media typeAccept: application/vnd.rms.v2+jsonPure RESTComplex, tooling kam
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/students")      // URI versioning
class StudentControllerV1 { ... }

@GetMapping(value = "/api/students", headers = "X-API-Version=2")      // header
@GetMapping(value = "/api/students", produces = "application/vnd.rms.v2+json") // media type
Dhyan doSpring Framework 7 / Boot 4 mein first-class API versioning aayi hai (@GetMapping(version = "2")). Boot 3.x mein upar wale manual tareeke use karo.
Q65

How do you design pagination, filtering and sorting in a REST API?

Main Definition

  • Keep the collection URL plain and put options in query parameters: filtering (?status=ACTIVE&city=Delhi), sorting (?sort=name,asc&sort=createdAt,desc) and paging (?page=0&size=20).
  • Always cap the page size, return paging metadata (page, size, totalElements, totalPages) and use a stable sort.
  • For huge or fast-changing data, cursor/keyset pagination (?after=lastId) is faster than offset.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Lakh records एक साथ भेजोगे तो app hang हो जाएगी, इसलिए page में भेजो।
  • Filter, sort और page सब query params में आते हैं, जैसे ?page=0&size=20&sort=name,asc।
  • Size की max limit रखो और response में totalPages जैसी जानकारी भी दो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Offset paging (page/size) simple hai, Spring Pageable direct support karta hai (Q165)
  • Deep pages pe offset slow: DB ko skip karna padta hai
  • Keyset/cursor: WHERE id > :lastId ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
  • Sort field whitelist karo (har column pe sort mat allow karo)
GET /api/v1/students?city=Delhi&page=0&size=2&sort=name,asc

200 OK
{
  "content": [ { "id": 7, "name": "Aman" }, { "id": 3, "name": "Ravi" } ],
  "page": 0, "size": 2, "totalElements": 5, "totalPages": 3
}
Q66

What are HATEOAS and idempotency keys, and what goes in a good API design checklist?

Main Definition

  • HATEOAS (Hypermedia As The Engine Of Application State) means responses include links to related actions (self, orders, cancel), so clients discover what they can do; Spring HATEOAS supports it but most APIs skip it.
  • An idempotency key (Idempotency-Key: <uuid> header) makes a POST safe to retry: the server stores the key with the result and returns the same result if the key repeats, so a payment isn't charged twice.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • HATEOAS में response के साथ links आते हैं कि आगे क्या कर सकते हो, जैसे website पर next page का button।
  • Idempotency key एक unique id है जो client POST के साथ भेजता है ताकि retry पर दूसरी बार payment ना कटे।
  • Server उस key को याद रखता है और duplicate पर पुराना result लौटा देता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
API design checklist
  • Nouns + plural + kebab-case, /api/v1 prefix
  • Sahi method + sahi status (201+Location, 204, 404, 409)
  • DTOs in/out, entity kabhi expose nahi
  • @Valid input + 400 with field errors
  • Ek consistent error format (Q80, Q81)
  • Pagination + max size, filters/sort query params mein
  • Auth (JWT), HTTPS, rate limit (429)
  • POST pe idempotency key jahan paisa/side-effect ho
  • OpenAPI docs + examples
  • Backward compatible changes; breaking = new version
POST /api/v1/payments
Idempotency-Key: 6f1c2a9e-...        <- client generate karta hai (UUID)
{ "orderId": 7, "amount": 499 }

// Server: key DB/Redis mein dekho
//  - nahi mili  -> payment karo, (key, response) save karo, 201 return
//  - mil gayi   -> wahi saved response dobara return, payment dobara NAHI

12. Spring Boot mein REST API banana

8 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Pichle topic mein REST ke rules seekhe: noun URLs, sahi methods, 201/204/404, pagination, versioning. Ab un rules ko Spring Boot code mein utarte hain. Ek poori Product CRUD API step by step banayenge jo production-style ho.
📖 Notes

Target: kya banana hai

MethodURLKaamStatus
GET/api/v1/products?page=0&size=10&sort=namePaged list200
GET/api/v1/products/{id}Ek product200 / 404
POST/api/v1/productsCreate201 + Location / 400 / 409
PUT/api/v1/products/{id}Full update200 / 404
PATCH/api/v1/products/{id}Price/stock update200 / 404
DELETE/api/v1/products/{id}Delete204 / 404

Step 1: dependencies

starter-web = Spring MVC + embedded Tomcat + Jackson. starter-validation = Hibernate Validator (Boot 2.3 ke baad web mein included nahi, alag daalna padta hai).

<dependencies>
  <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId></dependency>
  <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId></dependency>
  <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId></dependency>
  <dependency><groupId>com.h2database</groupId><artifactId>h2</artifactId><scope>runtime</scope></dependency>
  <dependency><groupId>org.springdoc</groupId><artifactId>springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui</artifactId><version>2.8.9</version></dependency>
  <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId><scope>test</scope></dependency>
</dependencies>

Step 2: Entity + Repository

@Entity
@Table(name = "products")
public class Product {
    @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;
    @Column(nullable = false, unique = true) private String name;
    @Column(nullable = false) private BigDecimal price;
    private int stock;
    private String internalNotes;          // ye API mein kabhi nahi jaana chahiye
    protected Product() {}
    public Product(String name, BigDecimal price, int stock) { this.name = name; this.price = price; this.stock = stock; }
    // getters / setters
}

public interface ProductRepository extends JpaRepository<Product, Long> {
    boolean existsByName(String name);
}

Step 3: DTO vs Entity (kyun alag?)

Entity = DB ka aaina. DTO = API ka contract. Entity seedha return kiya to internalNotes leak, bidirectional relation pe infinite JSON, lazy loading exception, aur client JSON mein id bhej ke dusre record ko overwrite kar sakta hai (mass assignment). Q70

// Input DTO: validation yahin
public record ProductRequest(
        @NotBlank(message = "name is required") @Size(max = 100) String name,
        @NotNull @Positive BigDecimal price,
        @Min(0) int stock) {}

// Partial update DTO: sab optional
public record ProductPatch(@Positive BigDecimal price, @Min(0) Integer stock) {}

// Output DTO
public record ProductResponse(Long id, String name, BigDecimal price, int stock) {
    public static ProductResponse from(Product p) {      // manual mapping
        return new ProductResponse(p.getId(), p.getName(), p.getPrice(), p.getStock());
    }
}
Real exampleBade projects mein MapStruct (@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")) compile-time pe mapper code generate karta hai: fast, type-safe. Chhote project mein manual from() kaafi hai.

Step 4: Service (business logic yahan)

public class ProductNotFoundException extends RuntimeException {
    public ProductNotFoundException(Long id) { super("Product " + id + " not found"); }
}
public class DuplicateProductException extends RuntimeException {
    public DuplicateProductException(String name) { super("Product '" + name + "' already exists"); }
}

@Service
@Transactional
public class ProductService {
    private final ProductRepository repo;
    public ProductService(ProductRepository repo) { this.repo = repo; }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<ProductResponse> list(Pageable pageable) {
        return repo.findAll(pageable).map(ProductResponse::from);
    }
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ProductResponse get(Long id) { return ProductResponse.from(find(id)); }

    public ProductResponse create(ProductRequest r) {
        if (repo.existsByName(r.name())) throw new DuplicateProductException(r.name());   // -> 409
        return ProductResponse.from(repo.save(new Product(r.name(), r.price(), r.stock())));
    }
    public ProductResponse replace(Long id, ProductRequest r) {      // PUT: sab fields
        Product p = find(id);
        p.setName(r.name()); p.setPrice(r.price()); p.setStock(r.stock());
        return ProductResponse.from(p);          // dirty checking, save() ki zaroorat nahi
    }
    public ProductResponse patch(Long id, ProductPatch r) {         // PATCH: sirf non-null
        Product p = find(id);
        if (r.price() != null) p.setPrice(r.price());
        if (r.stock() != null) p.setStock(r.stock());
        return ProductResponse.from(p);
    }
    public void delete(Long id) { repo.delete(find(id)); }

    private Product find(Long id) { return repo.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new ProductNotFoundException(id)); }
}

Step 5: @RestController vs @Controller + @ResponseBody

@RestController = @Controller + @ResponseBody. Matlab har method ka return value view name nahi, seedha Jackson se JSON ban ke body mein jaata hai. @Controller (bina @ResponseBody) JSP/Thymeleaf pages ke liye (pichla topic, Q55).

AnnotationShortcut forKaam
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/products")-Class level base path
@GetMapping@RequestMapping(method = GET)Read
@PostMappingmethod = POSTCreate
@PutMappingmethod = PUTReplace
@PatchMappingmethod = PATCHPartial update
@DeleteMappingmethod = DELETEDelete

Step 6: poora Controller

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/products")
@Tag(name = "Products")
public class ProductController {
    private final ProductService service;
    public ProductController(ProductService service) { this.service = service; }

    @GetMapping                                           // GET /api/v1/products?page=0&size=10&sort=name,asc
    public Page<ProductResponse> list(@PageableDefault(size = 10, sort = "name") Pageable pageable) {
        return service.list(pageable);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")                                  // GET /api/v1/products/5
    public ResponseEntity<ProductResponse> get(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(service.get(id));
    }

    @PostMapping                                          // POST -> 201 + Location
    public ResponseEntity<ProductResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody ProductRequest req) {
        ProductResponse saved = service.create(req);
        URI location = ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest()
                .path("/{id}").buildAndExpand(saved.id()).toUri();
        return ResponseEntity.created(location).body(saved);
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public ProductResponse replace(@PathVariable Long id, @Valid @RequestBody ProductRequest req) {
        return service.replace(id, req);                  // plain object = 200
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}")
    public ProductResponse patch(@PathVariable Long id, @Valid @RequestBody ProductPatch req) {
        return service.patch(id, req);
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
        service.delete(id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();        // 204
    }
}
Dhyan doController mein koi if/try-catch nahi. NotFound/Duplicate exceptions service phenkti hai, global handler unhe 404/409 banata hai (next topic). Controller patla, service mota. Q67

@PathVariable vs @RequestParam vs @RequestBody vs @RequestHeader

Q68

AnnotationKahan seExampleKab

@RequestParamQuery string?category=mobileFilter, optional (required=false, defaultValue)
@RequestBodyJSON body{"name":"Phone"}POST/PUT/PATCH data (Jackson)
@RequestHeaderHeaderIdempotency-Key: abcMeta info
@GetMapping("/search")    // GET /api/v1/products/search?category=mobile&maxPrice=20000
public List<ProductResponse> search(@RequestParam String category,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false) BigDecimal maxPrice,
                                    @RequestHeader(value = "X-Request-Id", required = false) String reqId) { ... }

ResponseEntity: status + headers + body

ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest() current URL (http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products) leta hai, usme /{id} jodta hai. Host/port hardcode nahi karna padta. Q69

  • ResponseEntity.ok(body) → 200
  • ResponseEntity.created(uri).body(dto) → 201 + Location
  • ResponseEntity.noContent().build() → 204
  • ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CONFLICT).body(err) → koi bhi
  • ResponseEntity.ok().eTag("\"v3\"").body(dto) → headers ke saath
  • Plain object return = hamesha 200; @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED) bhi chalta hai par header nahi de sakte

Bean Validation: galat data andar hi na aaye

DTO pe annotations + parameter pe @Valid. Fail hua to controller method chalta hi nahi; Spring MethodArgumentNotValidException phenkta hai → 400.

AnnotationCheck
@NotNullnull nahi
@NotBlankString null/empty/space nahi
@Size(min,max)Length / collection size
@EmailEmail format
@Min / @MaxNumber range
@Positive> 0
@Pattern(regexp)Regex
@Past / @FutureDates
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"","price":-5,"stock":3}'

HTTP/1.1 400
{ "status": 400, "message": "Validation failed",
  "errors": { "name": "name is required", "price": "must be greater than 0" } }
Common galti@Valid bhoolna (validation chalegi hi nahi), ya jakarta.validation ki jagah purana javax import. Field-error JSON wala handler: Q81. Q71

Jackson: Java ↔ JSON

starter-web ke saath Jackson aata hai. MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter @RequestBody ko JSON → object aur return value ko object → JSON karta hai. Records, getters, LocalDate (JavaTimeModule) sab Boot auto-configure karta hai.

public record UserResponse(
        @JsonProperty("full_name") String name,     // JSON key rename
        String email,
        @JsonIgnore String passwordHash,            // JSON mein nahi jaayega
        @JsonFormat(pattern = "dd-MM-yyyy") LocalDate joinedOn) {}

// Output: { "full_name": "Ram", "email": "ram@mail.com", "joinedOn": "14-10-2026" }

# application.yml
spring.jackson.default-property-inclusion: non_null   # null fields skip
spring.jackson.deserialization.fail-on-unknown-properties: false  # Boot ka default bhi false hai
Dhyan do@JsonIgnore entity pe lagana jugaad hai; asli fix DTO hai. Bidirectional relations pe infinite loop bhi DTO se hi khatam hota hai.

Content negotiation

Client Accept header se format maangta hai, server matching HttpMessageConverter chunta hai. Default JSON. jackson-dataformat-xml add karo to wahi endpoint XML bhi de sakta hai.

@GetMapping(value = "/{id}", produces = { MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, MediaType.APPLICATION_XML_VALUE })
public ProductResponse get(@PathVariable Long id) { ... }

@PostMapping(consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)    // sirf JSON body accept; warna 415

curl -H "Accept: application/xml" http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/1   # XML
curl -H "Accept: text/csv"        http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/1   # 406 Not Acceptable

Pagination endpoint (Pageable)

Spring Data Pageable seedha query params se bind hota hai: page, size, sort. Repo findAll(pageable) → Page<T>. Q165

curl "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products?page=0&size=2&sort=price,desc"

{ "content": [ { "id": 4, "name": "Laptop", "price": 55000, "stock": 3 },
               { "id": 1, "name": "Phone",  "price": 9999,  "stock": 20 } ],
  "page": { "size": 2, "number": 0, "totalElements": 5, "totalPages": 3 } }

# application.yml: max size limit
spring.data.web.pageable.max-page-size: 100
Dhyan doSpring Data 3.3+ mein Page ko seedha return karne pe warning aati hai (unstable JSON). @EnableSpringDataWebSupport(pageSerializationMode = VIA_DTO) lagao (upar wala page block isi ka shape hai) ya apna PageResponse DTO banao.

API docs: springdoc-openapi (Swagger UI)

Q72

  • Dependency: springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui (2.x for Boot 3)
  • UI: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html
  • Spec JSON: /v3/api-docs (frontend iss se client generate kar sakta hai)
  • Annotations: @Tag, @Operation(summary=...), @ApiResponse, @Schema(example=...)
  • Security ho to /swagger-ui/, /v3/api-docs/ permit karo
@Operation(summary = "Create product")
@ApiResponse(responseCode = "201", description = "Created")
@ApiResponse(responseCode = "409", description = "Name already exists")
@PostMapping
public ResponseEntity<ProductResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody ProductRequest req) { ... }

Manual testing: curl / Postman

Postman mein yahi requests ek Collection mein save karo, environment variable {{baseUrl}} rakho. Windows cmd mein single quotes kaam nahi karte; JSON ke andar \" use karo ya Git Bash / Postman use karo.

# Create
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"name":"Phone","price":9999,"stock":20}'
HTTP/1.1 201
Location: http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/1
{"id":1,"name":"Phone","price":9999,"stock":20}

# Read
curl http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/1          -> 200 {"id":1,...}
curl -i http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/999     -> 404 {"message":"Product 999 not found",...}

# Partial update
curl -X PATCH http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"stock":15}'
-> 200 {"id":1,"name":"Phone","price":9999,"stock":15}

# Duplicate
curl -i -X POST ... -d '{"name":"Phone","price":1,"stock":1}'   -> 409

# Delete
curl -i -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/1     -> 204 (no body)

Automated test: @WebMvcTest + MockMvc

Poora flow (DB ke saath) ke liye @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT) + TestRestTemplate. Q73

@WebMvcTest(ProductController.class)          // sirf web layer, DB nahi
class ProductControllerTest {
    @Autowired MockMvc mvc;
    @MockitoBean ProductService service;       // Boot 3.4+ (pehle @MockBean)

    @Test
    void get_found_returns200() throws Exception {
        when(service.get(1L)).thenReturn(new ProductResponse(1L, "Phone", new BigDecimal("9999"), 20));
        mvc.perform(get("/api/v1/products/1"))
           .andExpect(status().isOk())
           .andExpect(jsonPath("$.name").value("Phone"));
    }

    @Test
    void create_invalid_returns400() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/products").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{\"name\":\"\",\"price\":-5}"))
           .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
        verifyNoInteractions(service);          // validation fail = service call hi nahi
    }
}

CORS: browser frontend se call

React app http://localhost:3000 se http://localhost:8080 call kare to browser CORS ke wajah se block karta hai (alag origin). Postman/curl pe ye problem nahi hoti, sirf browser mein. Server ko batana padta hai kaunse origins allowed hain.

@Configuration
public class WebConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
    @Override
    public void addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry registry) {
        registry.addMapping("/api/**")
                .allowedOrigins("http://localhost:3000", "https://rms.example.com")
                .allowedMethods("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE")
                .allowedHeaders("*");
    }
}
// Ek controller ke liye: @CrossOrigin(origins = "http://localhost:3000")
// Spring Security hai to http.cors(Customizer.withDefaults()) bhi zaroori
Common galtiallowedOrigins("*") ke saath allowCredentials(true) nahi chalta. Production mein exact origins likho.

Doosri REST API call karna: RestClient

Kabhi tumhari API ko khud kisi aur API (payment, SMS, doosri service) ko call karna hota hai. Spring 6.1 / Boot 3.2+ ka RestClient modern, fluent, synchronous client hai (RestTemplate maintenance mode mein). Reactive ke liye WebClient.

@Service
public class InventoryClient {
    private final RestClient rest;
    public InventoryClient(RestClient.Builder builder) {          // Boot auto-configured builder
        this.rest = builder.baseUrl("http://localhost:8081/api/v1").build();
    }
    public StockResponse stock(Long productId) {
        return rest.get().uri("/stock/{id}", productId)
                .retrieve()
                .onStatus(HttpStatusCode::is4xxClientError,
                          (req, res) -> { throw new ProductNotFoundException(productId); })
                .body(StockResponse.class);
    }
}
Yaad rakhoMicroservices part mein yahi RestClient wapas aayega (service-to-service calls, @LoadBalanced, OpenFeign, Resilience4j retry).

RestTemplate: purana par ab bhi har jagah dikhta hai

Upar humne RestClient dekha. Par jab tum kisi purane project mein jaoge to bahut chance hai ki wahan RestTemplate mile. Dono ka kaam same hai: tumhara Spring app kisi doosri REST API ko call kare (jaise order-service ko product ka price chahiye).

RestTemplate ke methods ke naam hi batate hain kya karte hain: getForObject, postForEntity, put, delete, aur sab kuch kar sakne wala exchange. Response JSON Jackson se seedha Java object ban jaata hai. Poora code aur RestClient se comparison Q74 mein hai.

// GET: sirf body
ProductDto p = restTemplate.getForObject("/api/products/{id}", ProductDto.class, 5);

// POST: status + Location bhi chahiye
ResponseEntity<ProductDto> res = restTemplate.postForEntity("/api/products", req, ProductDto.class);
// res.getStatusCode() -> 201 CREATED
Kab kya use karoNaya blocking code: RestClient. Reactive app: WebClient. Purana code jisme RestTemplate hai: chalne do, dheere-dheere RestClient par le jao. RestTemplate maintenance mode mein hai, deprecated nahi.
📌 Yaad rakho
  • @RestController = @Controller + @ResponseBody → return value JSON
  • Layers: Controller (HTTP) → Service (logic, exceptions) → Repository; DTO in/out
  • POST → ResponseEntity.created(uri) (ServletUriComponentsBuilder), DELETE → 204
  • @PathVariable = identity, @RequestParam = filter, @RequestBody = JSON data, @RequestHeader = meta
  • @Valid + jakarta constraints → fail pe 400 (MethodArgumentNotValidException)
  • springdoc: /swagger-ui.html aur /v3/api-docs
  • @WebMvcTest + MockMvc + @MockitoBean = fast controller tests

✅ Review questions (8): ab khud check karo

Q67

How do you create a REST API in Spring Boot step by step? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • Add spring-boot-starter-web (plus -validation and -data-jpa), then build layers: an Entity + Repository, request/response DTOs, a Service with business logic and mapping, and a @RestController with @RequestMapping("/api/v1/products") and @GetMapping/@PostMapping/@PutMapping/@PatchMapping/@DeleteMapping methods returning ResponseEntity.
  • Add @Valid on bodies, a @RestControllerAdvice for errors, springdoc for docs and @WebMvcTest tests.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Step by step: starter-web dependency, फिर Entity और Repository, फिर DTO, फिर Service और आख़िर में @RestController।
  • Controller सिर्फ़ request लेता है और Service को देता है, logic Service में रहता है।
  • ऊपर से validation, global exception handler और Swagger docs जोड़ दो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  1. Dependencies: web, validation, data-jpa, DB driver, springdoc
  2. Entity Product + ProductRepository extends JpaRepository
  3. DTOs: ProductRequest (input, validation), ProductResponse (output)
  4. Mapper (manual / MapStruct)
  5. ProductService: business logic, NotFound exception
  6. ProductController: endpoints + ResponseEntity + status codes
  7. @RestControllerAdvice for errors
  8. Test with curl/Postman, @WebMvcTest, Swagger UI
Yaad rakhoPoora working code is topic ke notes mein hai (Product CRUD). Controller patla, Service mota.

Q68

What is the difference between @PathVariable, @RequestParam, @RequestBody and @RequestHeader? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • @PathVariable reads a value from the URL path (/products/{id}), used to identify one resource.
  • @RequestParam reads query string or form params (?page=0&q=phone), used for optional filters; supports required=false and defaultValue.
  • @RequestBody converts the JSON body into a Java object via Jackson (POST/PUT/PATCH).
  • @RequestHeader reads an HTTP header (e.g.
  • Idempotency-Key).

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • @PathVariable URL के अंदर से value लेता है जैसे /products/5 में 5।
  • @RequestParam ?
  • के बाद वाली values लेता है, जैसे filter और page।
  • @RequestBody पूरा JSON body Java object में बदलता है और @RequestHeader किसी header की value पढ़ता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
AnnotationSourceExampleUse
@PathVariableURL path/products/5Resource identity
@RequestParamQuery string?category=mobileFilter, sort, page
@RequestBodyJSON body{"name":"Phone"}Create/update data
@RequestHeaderHeaderAuthorization, X-Request-IdMeta info
// GET /api/v1/products/5
@GetMapping("/{id}")
ProductResponse get(@PathVariable Long id) { ... }

// GET /api/v1/products?category=mobile&minPrice=1000
@GetMapping
List<ProductResponse> search(@RequestParam(required = false) String category,
                             @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") BigDecimal minPrice) { ... }

// POST /api/v1/products   body: {"name":"Phone","price":9999}
@PostMapping
ResponseEntity<ProductResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody ProductRequest req,
                                       @RequestHeader(value = "Idempotency-Key", required = false) String key) { ... }
Common galtiSpring Boot 3.2+ mein -parameters compiler flag ke bina @PathVariable Long id naam resolve nahi hota. Boot ka Maven/Gradle plugin ye flag on rakhta hai; custom build mein dikkat aaye to @PathVariable("id") likho.
Important 25 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q67)★ Important listAgla important (Q69) → ★
Q69

Why return ResponseEntity from a controller, and how do you return 201 with a Location header? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • ResponseEntity<T> gives full control over the status code, headers and body.
  • Returning a plain object always gives 200.
  • For a create, return ResponseEntity.created(uri).body(dto), where the URI of the new resource is built with ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest().path("/{id}").buildAndExpand(id).toUri().
  • Use noContent().build() for 204 and ok(body) for 200.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Plain object return करोगे तो हमेशा 200 जाएगा।
  • ResponseEntity से status, headers और body तीनों control होते हैं।
  • नया record बनने पर 201 और Location header में नए record का URL भेजो, ताकि client उसे सीधे खोल सके।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • ResponseEntity.ok(body) = 200
  • created(uri).body(x) = 201
  • noContent().build() = 204
  • status(HttpStatus.CONFLICT).body(err) = custom
  • Alternative: @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED) on method (header nahi de sakte)
@PostMapping
public ResponseEntity<ProductResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody ProductRequest req) {
    ProductResponse saved = service.create(req);
    URI location = ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest()   // /api/v1/products
            .path("/{id}").buildAndExpand(saved.id()).toUri();       // /api/v1/products/11
    return ResponseEntity.created(location).body(saved);              // 201 + Location
}

@DeleteMapping("/{id}")
public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
    service.delete(id);
    return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();                        // 204
}
Important 26 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q68)★ Important listAgla important (Q70) → ★
Q70

Why use DTOs instead of entities in REST APIs, and how do you map them? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • Exposing JPA entities directly leaks internal fields (password, audit columns), couples the API contract to the DB schema, risks lazy-loading exceptions and infinite recursion in bidirectional relations, and enables mass assignment (client sets id or role).
  • DTOs (usually Java records) define exactly what goes in and out.
  • Map them manually in a mapper/service, or generate mappers with MapStruct.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Entity DB का आइना है और DTO API का contract।
  • Entity सीधे भेजोगे तो password जैसी fields leak हो सकती हैं और relations में infinite JSON loop बन सकता है।
  • DTO में सिर्फ़ वो fields रखो जो client को चाहिए, जैसे restaurant menu में kitchen की हर चीज़ नहीं लिखते।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Problem with entityDTO se fix
Password/internal fields leakSirf chahiye wali fields
LazyInitializationExceptionService mein data load karke DTO banao
Bidirectional = infinite JSONFlat DTO, no back-reference
Client id/role set kar deRequest DTO mein wo fields hi nahi
DB rename = API breakAPI contract alag
public record ProductRequest(@NotBlank String name, @NotNull @Positive BigDecimal price) {}
public record ProductResponse(Long id, String name, BigDecimal price) {}

// Manual mapper
static ProductResponse toResponse(Product p) {
    return new ProductResponse(p.getId(), p.getName(), p.getPrice());
}

// MapStruct (compile time code generate karta hai, reflection nahi)
@Mapper(componentModel = "spring")
public interface ProductMapper {
    ProductResponse toResponse(Product p);
    @Mapping(target = "id", ignore = true)
    Product toEntity(ProductRequest r);
}

Q71

How do you validate request bodies in a Spring Boot REST API? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • Add spring-boot-starter-validation, put Bean Validation annotations (jakarta.validation.constraints: @NotBlank, @Email, @Size, @Min, @Positive, @NotNull) on the DTO fields, and mark the parameter @Valid @RequestBody.
  • On failure Spring throws MethodArgumentNotValidException and returns 400; a @RestControllerAdvice turns it into a clean field-error JSON.
  • For @PathVariable/@RequestParam constraints, Spring 6.1+ validates them with HandlerMethodValidationException.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Validation के लिए DTO की fields पर @NotBlank, @Email, @Size जैसे annotations लगाओ और controller में @Valid लगाओ।
  • गलत data आया तो controller method चलेगा ही नहीं, सीधे 400 जाएगा।
  • Global handler से साफ़ field-wise error message भेजो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
public record StudentRequest(
    @NotBlank(message = "name is required") @Size(max = 50) String name,
    @NotBlank @Email String email,
    @Min(value = 18, message = "age must be at least 18") int age) {}

@PostMapping
public ResponseEntity<StudentResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody StudentRequest req) { ... }

// curl -X POST .../students -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"","email":"abc","age":15}'
// 400 Bad Request (handler ke baad)
{ "status": 400, "message": "Validation failed",
  "errors": { "name": "name is required", "email": "must be a well-formed email address",
              "age": "age must be at least 18" } }
Dhyan do@Valid bhool gaye to annotations bas decoration hain, koi check nahi hota. Handler ka poora code Q81 mein hai.

How do you document a REST API with OpenAPI / Swagger in Spring Boot?

Main Definition

  • Add springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui (2.x for Boot 3).
  • It scans controllers at runtime and serves the OpenAPI 3 spec at /v3/api-docs and an interactive Swagger UI at /swagger-ui.html (redirects to /swagger-ui/index.html).
  • Enrich it with @Tag, @Operation, @ApiResponse and @Schema.
  • Frontend teams can try endpoints or generate clients from the spec.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • springdoc dependency डालते ही app खुद API का documentation बना देती है।
  • /swagger-ui.html पर एक page खुलता है जहाँ हर endpoint दिखता है और वहीं से try भी कर सकते हो।
  • @Operation और @Schema से description और examples जोड़ सकते हो।

<dependency>

@GetMapping("/{id}")
public ProductResponse get(@PathVariable Long id) { ... }

// http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html   (UI)

Dhyan doSpring Security laga hai to /v3/api-docs/ aur /swagger-ui/ permit karo, aur production mein springdoc.swagger-ui.enabled=false socho.
Q73

How do you test a REST controller in Spring Boot?

Main Definition

  • Manually with curl/Postman, and automatically with @WebMvcTest(ProductController.class), which starts only the web layer (controllers, advice, Jackson, validation) and gives a MockMvc to fire fake HTTP requests.
  • The service is replaced with @MockitoBean (Boot 3.4+; @MockBean earlier).
  • Assert status, headers and JSON with jsonPath.
  • Use @SpringBootTest + TestRestTemplate/RestClient for full end-to-end tests.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • @WebMvcTest सिर्फ़ controller layer चलाता है, पूरी app नहीं, इसलिए test fast है।
  • MockMvc से fake request भेजो और status और JSON check करो।
  • Service को @MockitoBean से mock कर दो ताकि DB की ज़रूरत न पड़े।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
CORS aur RestClient bhi yaad rakho
  • Browser frontend (localhost:3000) se call fail = CORS. Fix: @CrossOrigin ya global WebMvcConfigurer.addCorsMappings (Security ho to http.cors())
  • Doosri API call karni ho to RestClient (Spring 6.1+). Microservices mein yahi phir aayega.
@WebMvcTest(ProductController.class)
class ProductControllerTest {
    @Autowired MockMvc mvc;
    @MockitoBean ProductService service;

    @Test
    void create_returns201() throws Exception {
        when(service.create(any())).thenReturn(new ProductResponse(11L, "Phone", new BigDecimal("9999")));
        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/products").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{"name":"Phone","price":9999}"))
           .andExpect(status().isCreated())
           .andExpect(header().string("Location", endsWith("/api/v1/products/11")))
           .andExpect(jsonPath("$.name").value("Phone"));
    }

    @Test
    void create_invalid_returns400() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(post("/api/v1/products").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .content("{"name":"","price":-5}"))
           .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }
}
Q74

What is RestTemplate, how do you use it, and should you still use it? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • RestTemplate is Spring's classic synchronous HTTP client for calling other REST APIs from Java code.
  • It offers methods like getForObject(), getForEntity(), postForEntity(), put(), delete() and the general exchange(), and converts JSON to Java objects using Jackson.
  • It is in maintenance mode: it still works and is common in older projects, but for new Spring Boot 3.2+ code Spring recommends RestClient (same blocking style, fluent API) or WebClient for reactive code.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • RestTemplate एक helper है जिससे आपका Spring app दूसरी REST API को call करता है, जैसे Postman, पर code के अंदर से।
  • ये response JSON को automatically Java object में बदल देता है।
  • ये पुराना है पर अभी भी काम करता है; नए code में RestClient use करो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
RestTemplateRestClientWebClient
StyleBlocking, template methodsBlocking, fluent APINon-blocking (reactive)
SinceSpring 3 (2009)Spring 6.1 / Boot 3.2Spring 5
StatusMaintenance mode (works, no new features)Recommended for new blocking codeReactive / WebFlux apps
Examplerest.getForObject(url, T.class)rest.get().uri(url).retrieve().body(T.class)web.get().uri(url).retrieve().bodyToMono(T.class)
Same call, teen clients mein
// RestTemplate (purana)
ProductDto p1 = restTemplate.getForObject("/api/products/{id}", ProductDto.class, 5);

// RestClient (Boot 3.2+, recommended)
ProductDto p2 = restClient.get().uri("/api/products/{id}", 5)
        .retrieve().body(ProductDto.class);

// WebClient (reactive)
Mono<ProductDto> p3 = webClient.get().uri("/api/products/{id}", 5)
        .retrieve().bodyToMono(ProductDto.class);
Common galtiyan
  • Har call par new RestTemplate() banana: timeout config nahi lagta aur interceptors miss. Ek bean banao (RestTemplateBuilder).
  • Timeout set na karna: doosri service hang hui to tumhare saare threads atak jaate hain.
  • 4xx/5xx exceptions handle na karna: HttpClientErrorException seedha 500 bankar client tak chala jaata hai.
  • List ke liye getForObject(url, List.class): generic type kho jaata hai (LinkedHashMap milte hain). exchange() + ParameterizedTypeReference use karo.
  • getForObject(url, Type.class): sirf body chahiye.
  • getForEntity(): body + status + headers (ResponseEntity).
  • postForEntity() / postForObject(): naya resource banana.
  • put() / delete(): kuch return nahi karte (void).
  • exchange(): koi bhi method + custom headers (jaise Authorization) + generic types (ParameterizedTypeReference).
  • 4xx par HttpClientErrorException, 5xx par HttpServerErrorException throw hota hai.
  • Bean RestTemplateBuilder se banao: timeout, base URL, interceptors ek jagah.
@Configuration
public class HttpClientConfig {
    @Bean
    RestTemplate restTemplate(RestTemplateBuilder builder) {
        return builder
            .rootUri("http://localhost:8081")          // product-service
            .setConnectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(2))  // Boot 3.4+: connectTimeout(...)
            .setReadTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(5))     // Boot 3.4+: readTimeout(...)
            .build();
    }
}

@Service
public class OrderService {
    private final RestTemplate rest;
    public OrderService(RestTemplate rest) { this.rest = rest; }

    public ProductDto getProduct(Long id) {
        // GET /api/products/5  ->  JSON  ->  ProductDto
        return rest.getForObject("/api/products/{id}", ProductDto.class, id);
    }

    public ProductDto create(CreateProductRequest req) {
        ResponseEntity<ProductDto> res =
            rest.postForEntity("/api/products", req, ProductDto.class);
        System.out.println(res.getStatusCode());            // 201 CREATED
        System.out.println(res.getHeaders().getLocation()); // /api/products/42
        return res.getBody();
    }

    public List<ProductDto> listWithToken(String jwt) {
        HttpHeaders h = new HttpHeaders();
        h.setBearerAuth(jwt);
        ResponseEntity<List<ProductDto>> res = rest.exchange(
            "/api/products", HttpMethod.GET, new HttpEntity<>(h),
            new ParameterizedTypeReference<List<ProductDto>>() {});
        return res.getBody();
    }

    public ProductDto safeGet(Long id) {
        try {
            return rest.getForObject("/api/products/{id}", ProductDto.class, id);
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException.NotFound e) {   // 404
            return null;
        } catch (ResourceAccessException e) {               // timeout / connection refused
            throw new IllegalStateException("product-service down", e);
        }
    }
}
Yaad rakhoRestTemplate deprecated nahi hai, bas naye features nahi aayenge. Purane project mein mile to chalne do; naya code RestClient mein likho. Dono same Jackson converters use karte hain, isliye migration aasan hai. Microservices mein service-name se call karne ke liye @LoadBalanced RestTemplate / RestClient.Builder bean banate hain (Q245).
Important 29 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q71)★ Important listAgla important (Q81) → ★
➡️ Agle topic mein: Exception handling. Service ne ProductNotFoundException phenka, ab use @RestControllerAdvice se ek saaf 404 JSON mein kaise badlein, aur validation errors ka 400 format kaise banayein.Agla topic: Exception handling →

13. Exception handling

8 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Pichle topic mein request ka happy path dekha: DispatcherServlet → Controller → JSON response. Par real life mein student nahi milta, email duplicate hota hai, input galat hota hai. Ab dekhte hain errors ko professional tareeke se kaise handle karein.
📖 Notes

HTTP response ke 3 hisse

Q75

  • Status code: result ka matlab (200, 404...)
  • Headers: metadata, jaise Content-Type: application/json
  • Body: actual data (JSON/XML)
Common galtiBeginner API har cheez pe 200 OK bhejti hai aur body mein likh deti hai "No data found". Galat! 200 ka matlab success hai. Client ko status code dekh ke hi samajh aana chahiye kya hua.

Status code families

Q76

FamilyMatlabExamples
1xxInformationalRequest mil gayi, processing chal rahi hai (100 Continue)
2xxSuccess200 OK = read/update safal; 201 Created = naya resource bana; 204 No Content = delete safal (body khaali)
3xxRedirection301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found: URL redirect
4xxClient ki galti400 Bad Request = invalid input/validation fail; 404 Not Found = resource DB mein nahi; 409 Conflict = duplicate (email pehle se hai). Aur 401/403 auth ke liye
5xxServer ki galti500 Internal Server Error = unhandled exception, bug, DB server down

REST endpoints ko standard banao

URL mein action words (/create, /get) mat likho. Resource URL mein, action HTTP verb mein.

BeginnerProfessionalKaam
POST /api/students/createPOST /api/studentsNaya student
GET /api/students/getGET /api/students/{id}Ek student
-GET /api/studentsSab students
PUT /api/students/updatePUT /api/students/{id}Poora update
DELETE /api/students/deleteDELETE /api/students/{id}Hard delete
-PATCH /api/students/{id}Partial update / soft delete

Problem: controller mein if-else

Har method mein if (student == null) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build(); likhoge to 3 problem:

  • Controller clutter: null-checks se controller bulky aur ganda
  • SRP violation: controller ka kaam sirf request lena aur service ko dena hai, exception handling nahi
  • Inconsistent errors: har controller alag format bhejega

Solution: do alag flows

Exception flow: Client → Controller → Service → exception throw → Global Exception Handler → Client. Q77

Happy: Client→Controller→Service→Repository→Controller→Client

Spring Boot ka default: /error

Q78

  1. Exception kahin handle nahi hua (custom handler nahi bana)
  2. Boot request ko special /error endpoint pe forward karta hai
  3. Postman/REST client ko default JSON: timestamp, status (500), error, path
  4. Browser ko Whitelabel Error Page (HTML)
Exception thrown→Spring MVC pakadta hai→/error endpoint→Default JSON / Whitelabel page
# application.properties (sirf local debugging ke liye)
server.error.include-message=always
Dhyan doVideo notes mein spring.web.error.include-message likha hai, wo Spring Boot 4 ka naam hai. Boot 3 mein server.error.include-message hai. Production mein message expose mat karo (security).

@ControllerAdvice vs @RestControllerAdvice

Q79

  • Andar har @ExceptionHandler(X.class) method X type ka exception kisi bhi controller se pakadta hai
  • Specific handler pehle match hota hai, Exception.class last fallback
@ControllerAdvice@RestControllerAdvice
Kya haiSaare controllers ka global helper@ControllerAdvice + @ResponseBody
ReturnView (HTML/JSP)JSON
UseTraditional MVCREST APIs

Step 1: custom exceptions + service

Custom exception = RuntimeException extend karo (unchecked, throws likhne ki zarurat nahi). JPA repo ke .orElseThrow() se seedha throw. Video mein @Autowired field injection hai; yahan constructor injection use kiya (Boot 3 best practice).

public class ResourceNotFoundException extends RuntimeException {
    public ResourceNotFoundException(String message) { super(message); }
}
public class DuplicateResourceException extends RuntimeException {
    public DuplicateResourceException(String message) { super(message); }
}

@Service
public class StudentService {
    private final StudentRepository repo;
    public StudentService(StudentRepository repo) { this.repo = repo; }

    public StudentResponseDTO getStudentById(Long id) {
        Student s = repo.findById(id)   // nahi mila to seedha throw
            .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Student with ID " + id + " not found"));
        return mapToDTO(s);
    }

    public StudentResponseDTO createStudent(StudentRequestDTO dto) {
        if (repo.existsByEmail(dto.getEmail()))   // duplicate check
            throw new DuplicateResourceException("Student with email " + dto.getEmail() + " already exists");
        Student saved = repo.save(mapToEntity(dto));
        return mapToDTO(saved);
    }

    public void deleteStudent(Long id) {
        Student s = repo.findById(id)   // delete se pehle bhi exist check
            .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Student with ID " + id + " not found"));
        repo.delete(s);
    }
}

Step 2: error DTOs (ek consistent format)

Q80

public class ExceptionResponseDTO {
    private LocalDateTime timestamp;
    private int status;        // 404
    private String error;      // "Not Found"
    private String message;    // ex.getMessage()
    private String path;       // request.getRequestURI()
    // all-args constructor, getters, setters
}

public class ValidationExceptionResponseDTO {
    private LocalDateTime timestamp;
    private int status;
    private String error;
    private String message;                  // "Validation Failed"
    private String path;
    private Map<String, String> fieldErrors; // field name -> error message
    // all-args constructor, getters, setters
}

Step 3: GlobalExceptionHandler

Q81

@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(ResourceNotFoundException.class)          // 404
    public ResponseEntity<ExceptionResponseDTO> handleNotFound(
            ResourceNotFoundException ex, HttpServletRequest request) {
        var body = new ExceptionResponseDTO(LocalDateTime.now(),
            HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND.value(), HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND.getReasonPhrase(),
            ex.getMessage(), request.getRequestURI());
        return new ResponseEntity<>(body, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(DuplicateResourceException.class)         // 409
    public ResponseEntity<ExceptionResponseDTO> handleDuplicate(
            DuplicateResourceException ex, HttpServletRequest request) {
        var body = new ExceptionResponseDTO(LocalDateTime.now(),
            HttpStatus.CONFLICT.value(), HttpStatus.CONFLICT.getReasonPhrase(),
            ex.getMessage(), request.getRequestURI());
        return new ResponseEntity<>(body, HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)    // 400, @Valid fail
    public ResponseEntity<ValidationExceptionResponseDTO> handleValidation(
            MethodArgumentNotValidException ex, HttpServletRequest request) {
        Map<String, String> errors = new HashMap<>();
        // BindingResult se har field ki error nikalo
        ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors()
          .forEach(fe -> errors.put(fe.getField(), fe.getDefaultMessage()));
        var body = new ValidationExceptionResponseDTO(LocalDateTime.now(),
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(), HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.getReasonPhrase(),
            "Validation Failed", request.getRequestURI(), errors);
        return new ResponseEntity<>(body, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)                          // 500 fallback (safety net)
    public ResponseEntity<ExceptionResponseDTO> handleGeneric(
            Exception ex, HttpServletRequest request) {
        var body = new ExceptionResponseDTO(LocalDateTime.now(),
            HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.value(),
            HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.getReasonPhrase(),
            "Something went wrong. Please try again later.",   // andar ki detail leak mat karo
            request.getRequestURI());
        return new ResponseEntity<>(body, HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR);
    }
}

Step 4: ab controller ekdum saaf

Q82

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/students")
public class StudentController {
    private final StudentService service;
    public StudentController(StudentService service) { this.service = service; }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<StudentResponseDTO> create(@Valid @RequestBody StudentRequestDTO dto) {
        return new ResponseEntity<>(service.createStudent(dto), HttpStatus.CREATED); // 201
    }
    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<StudentResponseDTO> get(@PathVariable Long id) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(service.getStudentById(id));                      // 200
    }
    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<StudentResponseDTO> update(@PathVariable Long id,
                                                     @Valid @RequestBody StudentRequestDTO dto) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(service.updateStudent(id, dto));                  // 200
    }
    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
        service.deleteStudent(id);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();                                 // 204
    }
}
Yaad rakhoKoi if-else nahi. POST → 201, GET/PUT → 200, DELETE → 204. Error aaya to handler sambhalega.

✅ Review questions (8): ab khud check karo

Q75

What are the parts of an HTTP response, and what makes an API professional?

Main Definition

  • Every HTTP response has a status code (meaning of the result), headers (key-value metadata like Content-Type) and a body (JSON/XML payload).
  • A beginner API returns 200 OK for everything and writes "No data found" in the body, which is wrong because 200 means success.
  • A professional API returns the correct status code and a consistent JSON error format, and uses resource paths with HTTP verbs instead of action words in URLs.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Response के तीन हिस्से होते हैं: status code, headers और body।
  • हर बार 200 भेजकर body में 'No data found' लिखना गलत है, क्योंकि 200 का मतलब success होता है।
  • Professional API सही status code और एक जैसा error JSON भेजती है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
REST endpoint standard
BeginnerProfessionalKaam
POST /api/students/createPOST /api/studentsNaya student
GET /api/students/getGET /api/students/{id}Ek student (@PathVariable)
-GET /api/studentsSab students
PUT /api/students/updatePUT /api/students/{id}Poora update
DELETE /api/students/deleteDELETE /api/students/{id}Delete
-PATCH /api/students/{id}Partial update / soft delete
  • Status code = result ka matlab
  • Headers = metadata
  • Body = actual data
  • URL mein /create, /get mat likho
Q76

What are the HTTP status code families, and which codes matter most?

Main Definition

  • Status codes fall into five families: 1xx informational, 2xx success, 3xx redirection, 4xx client errors and 5xx server errors.
  • Common ones are 200 OK, 201 Created, 204 No Content, 400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict and 500 Internal Server Error.
  • Choosing the right code tells the client what happened without reading the body.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • 2xx मतलब काम हो गया, 4xx मतलब client की गलती, 5xx मतलब server की गलती।
  • Create पर 201, delete पर 204, गलत input पर 400, data न मिले तो 404 और duplicate पर 409 भेजो।
  • Status code देखकर ही client समझ जाए कि क्या हुआ।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
FamilyMatlabExamples
1xxInformationalRequest mili, processing chal rahi
2xxSuccess200 OK (read/update), 201 Created, 204 No Content (delete, body khaali)
3xxRedirection301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found
4xxClient error400 Bad Request (validation), 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict (email already exists)
5xxServer error500 Internal Server Error (bug, DB down, unhandled exception)
Q77

Why is handling exceptions inside controllers a bad practice?

Main Definition

  • Putting if (student == null) return ResponseEntity.notFound().build() in every controller method makes controllers bulky, breaks the Single Responsibility Principle and produces inconsistent error formats across controllers.
  • The better design separates two flows.
  • The happy flow goes Controller → Service → Repository → back, while in the exception flow the service throws and a global exception handler builds the error response.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • हर controller method में null-check और error response लिखने से controller भारी और गंदा हो जाता है।
  • Controller का काम सिर्फ़ request लेना और service को देना है।
  • Service exception फेंके और एक global handler उसे पकड़कर एक जैसा error JSON बनाए।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Client→Controller→Service→throw Exception→Global Exception Handler→Client (error JSON)
Q78

How does Spring Boot handle exceptions by default?

Main Definition

  • If no custom handler exists, Spring Boot forwards an unhandled exception to the special /error endpoint.
  • REST clients like Postman get a default JSON with timestamp, status, error and path, while browsers get the Whitelabel Error Page.
  • To include the exception message during local debugging, set server.error.include-message=always, and keep it off in production.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Custom handler न हो तो Spring Boot exception को /error endpoint पर भेज देता है।
  • Postman को default JSON मिलता है और browser को Whitelabel Error Page दिखता है।
  • Message देखना हो तो include-message property लगाओ, पर production में नहीं।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
# application.properties (sirf local debugging)
server.error.include-message=always
Dhyan doNotes mein property ka naam spring.web.error.include-message likha hai, jo naye Spring Boot 4 naming ke hisaab se hai. Spring Boot 3 mein ye server.error.include-message hai. Production mein message expose mat karo (security).
Q79

What is the difference between @ControllerAdvice and @RestControllerAdvice, and what does @ExceptionHandler do?

Main Definition

  • @ControllerAdvice is a global helper for traditional MVC apps that render HTML/JSP views.
  • @RestControllerAdvice = @ControllerAdvice + @ResponseBody, so returned objects are serialized to JSON, which is what REST APIs need.
  • Inside it, each @ExceptionHandler(SomeException.class) method catches that exception type from any controller and returns a proper ResponseEntity.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • @RestControllerAdvice पूरी app के exceptions एक जगह पकड़ने वाली class है, और ये return object को JSON बना देती है।
  • @ControllerAdvice पुरानी JSP वाली apps के लिए है।
  • अंदर हर @ExceptionHandler method एक खास exception को संभालता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • @ControllerAdvice → views
  • @RestControllerAdvice → JSON
  • @ExceptionHandler(X.class) → X ke liye handler
  • Specific handler pehle match hota hai, Exception.class fallback
Q80

How do you create custom exceptions and error DTOs, and throw them from the service layer?

Main Definition

  • Custom exceptions such as ResourceNotFoundException and DuplicateResourceException extend RuntimeException and pass a message to super.
  • The service throws them, for example with findById(id).orElseThrow(...) or after an existsByEmail check.
  • A standard error DTO (timestamp, status, error, message, path) and a validation DTO that adds Map<String,String> fieldErrors keep every error response consistent.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • RuntimeException को extend करके अपनी exception class बनाओ और service में orElseThrow से सीधा throw करो।
  • Error भेजने के लिए एक fixed DTO बनाओ जिसमें timestamp, status, error, message और path हों।
  • Validation के लिए अलग DTO में field-wise errors का map रखो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Error DTOs
public class ExceptionResponseDTO {
    private LocalDateTime timestamp;
    private int status;
    private String error;
    private String message;
    private String path;
    // all-args constructor, getters, setters
}

public class ValidationExceptionResponseDTO {
    private LocalDateTime timestamp;
    private int status;
    private String error;
    private String message;
    private String path;
    private Map<String, String> fieldErrors;   // field -> error message
}
public class ResourceNotFoundException extends RuntimeException {
    public ResourceNotFoundException(String message) { super(message); }
}
public class DuplicateResourceException extends RuntimeException {
    public DuplicateResourceException(String message) { super(message); }
}

@Service
public class StudentService {
    private final StudentRepository studentRepository;
    public StudentService(StudentRepository repo) { this.studentRepository = repo; }

    public StudentResponseDTO getStudentById(Long id) {
        Student student = studentRepository.findById(id)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Student with ID " + id + " not found"));
        return mapToDTO(student);
    }

    public StudentResponseDTO createStudent(StudentRequestDTO dto) {
        if (studentRepository.existsByEmail(dto.getEmail())) {
            throw new DuplicateResourceException("Student with email " + dto.getEmail() + " already exists");
        }
        return mapToDTO(studentRepository.save(mapToEntity(dto)));
    }

    public void deleteStudent(Long id) {
        Student student = studentRepository.findById(id)
            .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Student with ID " + id + " not found"));
        studentRepository.delete(student);
    }
}
Q81

Write a complete GlobalExceptionHandler, including validation errors and a fallback. ★ Important

Main Definition

  • A @RestControllerAdvice class has one @ExceptionHandler per case: 404 for ResourceNotFoundException, 409 for DuplicateResourceException, 400 for MethodArgumentNotValidException (thrown when @Valid fails) and a 500 fallback for Exception.class.
  • Each handler builds the error DTO using HttpStatus, ex.getMessage() and request.getRequestURI().
  • Validation errors are collected from ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors() into a field-to-message map.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • हर exception के लिए अलग handler: not found पर 404, duplicate पर 409, validation fail पर 400 और बाकी सब पर 500।
  • Validation में BindingResult से हर field की error निकालकर map में डालते हैं।
  • 500 वाले में असली message नहीं, एक generic safe message भेजो।
