18. Pointcuts aur proxies

7 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Advice ne bataya KAB aur KYA chalana hai. Ab bacha KAHAN — kaunse methods/classes intercept honge. Ye kaam Pointcut karta hai. Aur end mein dekhenge ki ye sab chalane wala Proxy andar se kaisa hota hai.
📖 Notes

execution() pointcut ki anatomy

  • Mandatory: return type, package.Class.method path, parameter list.
  • Optional: access modifier (public), throws clause.
execution( modifier?  return-type  package.Class.method(params)  throws? )

// example:
execution( public  String  in.codearmy.service.StudentService.getStudent(String) )

Exact matching ki problem

Ye sirf ek method pakadta hai. Har method ke liye aisa likhoge to AOP ka fayda (modularity) hi khatam. Isliye wildcards.

@Before("execution(public String in.codearmy.service.StudentService.getStudent(String))")
public void logBefore(JoinPoint jp) { System.out.println("Method intercepted"); }

Wildcards: * aur ..

WildcardMatlabExampleKya match hota hai
*Koi bhi ek elementexecution(* ...StudentService.getStudent(..))Koi bhi return type
*Naam ka hissaexecution(* ...StudentService.get*(..))get se shuru hone wale methods
*Koi bhi classexecution(* com.service.*.*(..))com.service ki direct classes (sub-package nahi)
..Zero ya zyada paramsStudentService.*(..)0, 1, ya kai params
..Saare sub-packagesexecution(* com.service..*.*(..))com.service + uske andar ke saare packages
Yaad rakho* = ek cheez, .. = kitni bhi cheezein (params ya packages). (*) = exactly ek param, () = zero params. Q108

Khatarnak: bahut broad pointcut

* *(..) ka matlab 'har bean ka har method' — Spring Boot ki apni auto-configuration beans bhi. Spring unke proxy banane ki koshish karta hai; kuch proxy ho hi nahi sakte (final classes, jaise kuch web server factory beans) aur app boot hote hi BeanCreationException de deta hai.

// BURA: startup pe BeanCreationException
@Before("execution(* *(..))")

// ACHHA: apne base package tak seemit
@Before("execution(* in.codearmy.aopdemo..*.*(..))")
Common galtiPointcut hamesha apne application ke base package se bandho. Q109

Core designators

DesignatorLevelKya match karta haiExample
execution()MethodMethod signatureexecution(* com.service..*.*(..))
within()Class / packageUs class/package ke saare methodswithin(com.service.StudentService)
@annotation()MethodJis method pe given annotation lagi ho@annotation(in.codearmy.annotation.TrackTime)
bean()Bean name (Spring-only)IoC bean naam sebean(studentService)
@Service
public class StudentService {
    @TrackTime   // custom annotation — bas lagao aur aspect chal jayega
    public Student createStudent(Student s) { ... }
}

@Around("@annotation(in.codearmy.annotation.TrackTime)")
public Object measureTime(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp) throws Throwable {
    long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
    Object result = pjp.proceed();
    System.out.println("Time taken: " + (System.currentTimeMillis() - start) + " ms");
    return result;
}
Dhyan do@annotation sabse clean hai — package structure se bandha nahi. Agle topic mein isi ko detail mein karenge. Q110

Named pointcuts — ek jagah centralize karo

Har advice mein same lambi string copy karna = duplication. Industry tarika: ek class mein @Pointcut ke saath khaali methods banao, aur &&, ||, ! se combine karo.

public class ApplicationPointcuts {

    @Pointcut("within(in.codearmy.controller..*)")
    public void controllerLayer() {}

    @Pointcut("within(in.codearmy.service..*)")
    public void serviceLayer() {}

    @Pointcut("execution(public * *(..))")
    public void publicMethods() {}

    @Pointcut("serviceLayer() && publicMethods()")   // combine
    public void publicServiceMethods() {}
}

@Aspect
@Component
public class LoggingAspect {
    // fully-qualified method naam se refer karo
    @Before("in.codearmy.aspect.ApplicationPointcuts.publicServiceMethods()")
    public void logPublicService(JoinPoint jp) {
        System.out.println("Executing: " + jp.getSignature().getName());
    }
}
Yaad rakhoYahan execution(public * *(..)) akela khatarnak hota, par serviceLayer() && ke saath safe hai. Q111

Advanced designators: @within, @target, args, @args

Example: StudentService (pe @Service) extends BaseService (bina annotation), aur save() BaseService mein declared hai. @within(Service) → save() nahi pakdega (declare BaseService mein hua). @target(Service) → pakdega (runtime object StudentService hai).

DesignatorKya check karta hai
@within(Ann)Jis class mein method declare hua hai us pe Ann hai?
@target(Ann)Runtime object ki class pe Ann hai?
args(Type)Method ka runtime argument is type ka hai? (within() ke saath combine karo)
@args(Ann)Argument ki class pe Ann annotation hai? (jaise @ValidatedDto)
Dhyan doQ112

Proxy ke do type: CGLIB vs JDK Dynamic Proxy

CGLIB proxyJDK dynamic proxy
Kaise banta haiTarget class ka subclass (extends StudentService)Target ke interface ko implement karta hai
Proxy IS-AStudentService (class)Sirf interface — concrete class nahi
KabSpring Boot default (spring.aop.proxy-target-class=true)proxy-target-class=false aur bean koi interface implement kare
Limitfinal class / final method proxy nahi ho saktaSirf interface methods intercept; concrete class type se inject karoge to fail
# application.properties — JDK proxy force karne ke liye
spring.aop.proxy-target-class=false

this() vs target()

target() asli business object check karta hai, this() proxy object. Q113

Proxy typetarget(StudentService)this(StudentService)
CGLIBMatchMatch (proxy extends StudentService)
JDKMatchFail (proxy sirf interface implement karta hai)

Self-invocation trap

Advice sirf tab chalta hai jab call proxy se guzre. Agar bean ke andar ek method doosre method ko this.otherMethod() se call kare, to call seedha target pe jati hai — proxy bypass, advice nahi chalega. Yahi problem @Transactional aur @Async ke saath bhi aati hai.

@Service
public class StudentService {
    public void bulkCreate(List<Student> list) {
        list.forEach(this::createStudent); // ❌ proxy bypass — @TrackTime nahi chalega
    }
    @TrackTime
    public void createStudent(Student s) { ... }
}
Common galtiFix: method ko alag bean mein le jao, ya same bean ka proxy inject karo (@Lazy self-injection) aur usse call karo. Q114
📌 Yaad rakho
  • execution(modifier? returnType package.Class.method(params) throws?) — return type, path, params mandatory.
  • * = ek element, .. = zero ya zyada (params / sub-packages).
  • execution(* *(..)) → BeanCreationException; base package se restrict karo.
  • Designators: execution, within, @annotation, bean, @within/@target, args/@args, this/target.
  • Named pointcuts: @Pointcut + khaali method, && || ! se combine.
  • CGLIB (subclass) Boot default; JDK proxy sirf interface — tab this(Class) fail.
  • Self-invocation proxy bypass karta hai → advice nahi chalta.

✅ Review questions (7): ab khud check karo

Q108

What is the anatomy of an execution() pointcut, and how do the * and .. wildcards work?

Main Definition

  • The form is execution(modifiers? return-type package.Class.method(params) throws?), where the return type, method path and parameter list are mandatory and the access modifier and throws clause are optional.
  • * matches one element, such as any return type, a name part like get*, or any class in a package.
  • .. matches zero or more elements: any number of parameters in (..) or all sub-packages in service..*.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • execution() में return type, package.class.method और parameters ज़रूरी हैं, access modifier और throws optional।
  • * किसी एक चीज़ को match करता है, जैसे कोई भी return type या get से शुरू होने वाले methods।
  • ..
  • zero या ज़्यादा को match करता है, जैसे कितने भी parameters या सारे sub-packages।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
WildcardMatchExample
*Exactly ek element* return type, get*, service.*
..Zero ya zyada(..) params, service..* sub-packages
// exact (har method ke liye alag likhna padega - modular nahi)
@Before("execution(public String in.codearmy.service.StudentService.getStudent(String))")

execution(* com.service.StudentService.getStudent(..))  // koi bhi return type, koi bhi params
execution(* com.service.StudentService.get*(..))        // get se shuru hone wale methods
execution(* com.service.*.*(..))                        // com.service ki har class (direct)
execution(* com.service..*.*(..))                       // com.service + saare sub-packages
Q109

Why is an overly broad pointcut like execution(* *(..)) dangerous?

Main Definition

  • execution(* *(..)) tells Spring to advise every method of every bean, including Spring Boot's own auto-configuration beans.
  • Spring then tries to create proxies for internal beans, some of which cannot be proxied (for example final classes such as web server factories), and startup fails with a BeanCreationException.
  • Always restrict pointcuts to your application's base package, for example execution(* in.codearmy.aopdemo..*.*(..)).

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • execution(* *(..)) लिखा तो Spring अपने internal beans पर भी proxy बनाने की कोशिश करता है।
  • कुछ beans proxy नहीं हो सकते, तो app start होते ही BeanCreationException आता है।
  • Pointcut हमेशा अपने base package तक सीमित रखो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
// BAD: startup par BeanCreationException
@Before("execution(* *(..))")

// GOOD: sirf apni application
@Before("execution(* in.codearmy.aopdemo..*.*(..))")
Q110

What are the core pointcut designators: execution, within, @annotation and bean?

Main Definition

  • execution() matches method signatures.
  • within() matches all methods inside given classes or packages.
  • @annotation() matches methods carrying a specific annotation, which is the cleanest way to opt in method by method.
  • bean() is Spring-specific and matches all methods of a bean by its IoC bean name.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • execution() method signature से match करता है, within() पूरी class या package से।
  • @annotation() उन methods को पकड़ता है जिन पर कोई खास annotation लगी हो।
  • bean() Spring का अपना है जो bean के नाम से match करता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
DesignatorLevelExample
execution()Method signatureexecution(* com.service..*.*(..))
within()Class / packagewithin(com.service.StudentService), within(com.service..*)
@annotation()Annotated method@annotation(in.codearmy.annotation.TrackTime)
bean()Bean name (Spring only)bean(studentService), bean(*Service)
@Service
public class StudentService {
    @TrackTime
    public Student createStudent(Student student) { ... }
}

@Around("@annotation(in.codearmy.annotation.TrackTime)")
public Object measureTime(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp) throws Throwable {
    long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
    Object result = pjp.proceed();
    System.out.println("Time taken: " + (System.currentTimeMillis() - start) + " ms");
    return result;
}
Q111

How do you centralize and combine pointcuts with @Pointcut?

Main Definition

  • Repeating pointcut strings in every advice causes duplication.
  • Industry practice is to declare named pointcuts in one class using @Pointcut on empty methods, such as controllerLayer(), serviceLayer() and publicMethods().
  • They can be combined with &&, || and !.
  • Advices then refer to them by fully-qualified method name, such as in.codearmy.aspect.ApplicationPointcuts.publicServiceMethods().

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • हर advice में वही pointcut string दोहराने की जगह एक class में @Pointcut से नाम वाले pointcuts बना लो।
  • उन्हें && , || और !
  • से जोड़ सकते हो।
  • Advice में बस उस method का पूरा नाम लिखो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
public class ApplicationPointcuts {
    @Pointcut("within(in.codearmy.controller..*)")
    public void controllerLayer() {}

    @Pointcut("within(in.codearmy.service..*)")
    public void serviceLayer() {}

    @Pointcut("execution(public * *(..))")
    public void publicMethods() {}

    @Pointcut("serviceLayer() && publicMethods()")
    public void publicServiceMethods() {}
}

@Aspect
@Component
public class LoggingAspect {
    @Before("in.codearmy.aspect.ApplicationPointcuts.publicServiceMethods()")
    public void log(JoinPoint jp) {
        System.out.println("Executing: " + jp.getSignature().getName());
    }
}
Q112

What do @within, @target, args and @args match?

Main Definition

  • @within(Ann) and @target(Ann) both match classes annotated with Ann.
  • @within looks at the type where the method is declared, while @target looks at the runtime object's class, so an inherited method from an un-annotated base class matches @target but not @within.
  • args(Type) matches methods whose runtime arguments are of that type (combine with within() to stay inside your code).
  • @args(Ann) matches methods whose argument's class carries annotation Ann.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • @within देखता है method किस class में लिखा गया है, @target देखता है runtime पर object किस class का है।
  • इसलिए base class से आया method @target से पकड़ा जाएगा पर @within से नहीं।
  • args() argument के type से match करता है और @args() argument की class पर लगी annotation से।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
DesignatorKya dekhta haiExample
@within(Service)Method jis class mein DECLARE hua uspar annotationBaseService.save() (bina @Service) match nahi
@target(Service)RUNTIME object ki class par annotationStudentService @Service hai to inherited save() bhi match
args(Student)Argument ka runtime typewithin(in.codearmy..*) && args(in.codearmy.dto.Student)
@args(ValidatedDto)Argument ki class par annotation@args(in.codearmy.annotation.ValidatedDto)
Q113

What is the difference between CGLIB and JDK dynamic proxies, and how do this() and target() behave? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • A CGLIB proxy is a generated subclass of the target class, so it IS-A StudentService; it is Spring Boot's default (spring.aop.proxy-target-class=true).
  • A JDK dynamic proxy only implements the target's interfaces, so it is NOT an instance of the concrete class.
  • It is used when you set spring.aop.proxy-target-class=false and the bean implements an interface.
  • target(Type) checks the real object and this(Type) checks the proxy, so this(StudentService) fails with a JDK proxy.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • CGLIB proxy target class को extend करता है, इसलिए वो StudentService ही है, और Spring Boot में default यही है।
  • JDK proxy सिर्फ़ interface implement करता है, concrete class का नहीं होता।
  • इसलिए JDK proxy में this(StudentService) match नहीं करता, पर target() करता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Proxytarget(StudentService)this(StudentService)
CGLIBMatchMatch (proxy extends class)
JDK dynamicMatchFAIL (proxy sirf interface implement karta)
# JDK dynamic proxy force karne ke liye (bean interface implement kare tab)
spring.aop.proxy-target-class=false
Dhyan doCGLIB subclass banata hai, isliye final class ya final/private methods advise nahi ho sakte. JDK proxy ke saath concrete class type se inject karoge (StudentServiceImpl) to injection fail ho jaayega; interface type se inject karo.
Important 39 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q107)★ Important listAgla important (Q114) → ★
Q114

What is the self-invocation problem in Spring AOP? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • Advice runs only when a call goes through the proxy.
  • If a method inside a bean calls another method of the same bean (this.otherMethod()), the call goes directly to the target object, so no advice runs on the inner method.
  • The same applies to @Transactional and @Async.
  • Fixes are to move the method to another bean, or inject the proxy of the same bean (for example with @Lazy self-injection) and call through it.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Advice तभी चलती है जब call proxy से होकर आए।
  • Same class के अंदर एक method दूसरे को this से बुलाए तो call सीधा असली object पर जाती है और advice skip हो जाती है।
  • इसीलिए अंदर से बुलाए गए @Transactional method पर भी transaction नहीं लगता।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
@Service
public class StudentService {
    public void importAll(List<StudentDTO> list) {
        list.forEach(this::createStudent);   // this = target, proxy nahi -> advice NAHI chalegi
    }

    @TrackExecutionTime
    public StudentDTO createStudent(StudentDTO s) { ... }
}
// Fix: createStudent ko alag bean mein le jao, ya proxy inject karke usse call karo
Yaad rakhoBahar se aaya call: Controller → Proxy → Target (advice chalti). Andar ka call: Target → Target (advice nahi).

19. Custom annotations ke saath AOP

5 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Pichle topic mein @annotation() designator ki jhalak dekhi. Ab use poori tarah build karte hain: apni custom annotation banao, aspect likho, aur samjho ki Spring startup pe proxy kab substitute karta hai.
📖 Notes

Problem: execution() mein sab hardcode

execution(* in.codearmy.service.StudentService.getStudent(..)) mein package, class, method, params sab hardcoded hain. Package rename kiya ya method move hua — pointcut chupchaap match karna band kar deta hai, koi error nahi aata.

Solution: declarative tarika. Developer bas method pe @TrackExecutionTime laga de, aur aspect apna kaam kar le. Jaise @Transactional lagate ho — waise hi.

Real exampleSetup: StudentController (POST/GET /api/students) → StudentService (createStudent(StudentDTO), getStudent(String)) → aspect beech mein intercept. Q115

Custom annotation kaise banti hai: @interface

TypeMatlabExample
Marker annotationKoi attribute nahi, sirf 'mark' karti hai@TrackExecutionTime
Configured annotationAttributes + default values (extra metadata)@TrackExecutionTime(warnAfter = 1500)
package in.codearmy.annotation;

public @interface TrackExecutionTime {
    // abhi khaali = marker annotation
}

Meta-annotations (annotation ki annotation)

  • SOURCE — sirf source code mein, compiler hata deta hai (jaise @Override).
  • CLASS — .class file mein hai par runtime pe reflection se nahi dikhti. Default yahi hai!
  • RUNTIME — runtime pe reflection se dikhti hai. Spring AOP isi se pointcut match karta hai.
  • @Target na lagao to annotation lagbhag har declaration (class, method, field, param...) pe lag sakti hai.
Meta-annotationSawaalAOP ke liye kya lagao
@TargetKahan lag sakti hai?ElementType.METHOD (class ke liye TYPE, FIELD, PARAMETER bhi hote hain)
@RetentionKab tak zinda rahegi?RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME — zaroori!
@DocumentedJavaDoc mein dikhe?Optional
Common galti@Retention(RUNTIME) bhool gaye → default CLASS → Spring ko annotation dikhegi hi nahi → aspect kabhi nahi chalega, koi error bhi nahi. Q116

Final annotation: @TrackExecutionTime

package in.codearmy.annotation;

import java.lang.annotation.*;

@Target(ElementType.METHOD)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Documented
public @interface TrackExecutionTime {
    long warnAfter() default 2000;   // itne ms se zyada laga to warning
    String operation() default "";   // operation ka readable naam
}

Aspect: @Around + annotation binding

@Aspect
@Component
public class PerformanceAspect {

    @Around("@annotation(trackExecutionTime)")   // binding form: param ka naam
    public Object measureExecutionTime(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp,
                                       TrackExecutionTime trackExecutionTime) throws Throwable {
        long start = System.currentTimeMillis();       // 1. timer start
        try {
            return pjp.proceed();                       // 2. asli method, result wapas
        } finally {                                     // 3. exception aaye tab bhi chalega
            long duration = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;

            String operation = trackExecutionTime.operation();
            if (operation.isBlank()) {
                operation = pjp.getSignature().getName(); // fallback: method ka naam
            }

            if (duration >= trackExecutionTime.warnAfter()) {
                System.out.println("SLOW OPERATION ALERT! " + operation + ": " + duration + " ms");
            } else {
                System.out.println("Time taken by " + operation + ": " + duration + " ms");
            }
        }
    }
}
Dhyan dofinally isliye ki method fail ho tab bhi time log ho. Annotation ke attributes (warnAfter, operation) seedhe parameter se padh rahe hain. Q117

Service mein use + output

Console output kuch aisa:

GET → SLOW OPERATION ALERT! Get Student Data: 2003 ms→POST → Student Saved→Time taken by Creating New Student: 2 ms
@Service
public class StudentService {

    @TrackExecutionTime(warnAfter = 1500, operation = "Get Student Data")
    public String getStudent(String data) {
        try { Thread.sleep(2000); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
        return "All Student Data";   // slow operation ka mock
    }

    @TrackExecutionTime(warnAfter = 2000, operation = "Creating New Student")
    public StudentDTO createStudent(StudentDTO student) {
        System.out.println("Student Saved");
        return student;
    }
}

Type-matching form vs Binding form

Type-matching formBinding form (recommended)
Likhte kaise@annotation(in.codearmy.annotation.TrackExecutionTime) (FQCN)@annotation(trackTimeAttr) (param naam)
Advice signaturemeasure(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp)measure(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp, TrackExecutionTime trackTimeAttr)
Attributes padh sakte?Seedhe nahi (reflection karna padega)Haan — trackTimeAttr.warnAfter()
Common galti@annotation(...) ke andar ka naam aur advice parameter ka naam exactly same hona chahiye, warna startup pe IllegalArgumentException: error at ::0 formal unbound in pointcut. Q118

Andar se: proxy startup pe kab banta hai?

  1. Spring bean definitions padhta hai.
  2. StudentService ka asli object (target) banata hai.
  3. Dependencies inject karta hai.
  4. Init callbacks chalte hain (@PostConstruct).
  5. AOP ka BeanPostProcessor (auto-proxy creator, AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator) postProcessAfterInitialization() mein check karta hai: kya kisi aspect ka pointcut is bean ke kisi method se match karta hai?
  6. Match hua → CGLIB/JDK proxy banake asli bean ki jagah context mein rakh deta hai. Nahi hua → original bean hi rehta hai.
  7. Ab StudentController mein StudentService autowire hoga to use proxy milega.
public interface BeanPostProcessor {
    default Object postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object bean, String name) { return bean; }
    default Object postProcessAfterInitialization(Object bean, String name)  { return bean; } // ← yahan proxy return hota hai
}

Performance: matching startup pe hi

Spring startup pe hi decide kar leta hai kaunsa advice kaunse method pe lagega, aur ye method → advice chain cache kar leta hai. Runtime pe har call pe saare aspects scan nahi hote — bas cached chain chalti hai, isliye overhead kam hai.

Yaad rakhoProxy creation = BeanPostProcessor, postProcessAfterInitialization phase. Q119

Aage ka connection: @Transactional bhi AOP hai

Jo @Transactional hum agle Part (Database/JPA) mein use karenge, wo bhi exactly isi tarah kaam karta hai: Spring ka ek aspect (TransactionInterceptor) proxy ke through method ko gherta hai — pehle transaction begin, method chalao, success pe commit, exception pe rollback. Isiliye self-invocation wala trap @Transactional pe bhi lagta hai.

Kab custom annotation + AOP use karo

  • Use karo: timing/metrics, audit log, custom auth check (@Authenticate), rate-limit, retry — jo cheez kai methods pe opt-in chahiye.
  • Mat karo: asli business rules aspect mein chhupana — padhne wale ko pata hi nahi chalega ki method ke saath kya ho raha hai.
  • Mat bhoolo: private/final methods aur self-calls pe Spring AOP kaam nahi karta (proxy based hai).
📌 Yaad rakho
  • Custom annotation = @interface; marker (khaali) vs configured (attributes + default).
  • @Target(METHOD) + @Retention(RUNTIME) — RUNTIME ke bina AOP annotation dekh hi nahi sakta.
  • Binding form: @annotation(name) + same naam ka parameter → attributes seedhe padho.
  • Timing aspect: @Around + try { return proceed() } finally { duration log }.
  • Proxy BeanPostProcessor ke postProcessAfterInitialization mein banta hai aur asli bean ko replace karta hai.
  • @Transactional bhi isi AOP proxy mechanism par chalta hai.

✅ Review questions (5): ab khud check karo

Q115

Why use custom annotations with AOP instead of execution() pointcuts?

Main Definition

  • An execution(...) pointcut hardcodes package paths, class names and parameter types, so it breaks when code moves and is hard to read.
  • With the @annotation designator, an aspect intercepts any method marked with a chosen annotation.
  • A custom annotation such as @TrackExecutionTime or @Authenticate gives a declarative style: the developer just puts the annotation on a business method, and the aspect applies the infrastructure logic.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • execution() में package, class और parameter के नाम hardcode होते हैं, code move हुआ तो pointcut टूट जाता है।
  • Custom annotation से बस method पर @TrackExecutionTime लगाओ और aspect खुद काम कर देगा।
  • ये ऐसा है जैसे सामान पर 'Fragile' sticker लगाना, बाकी handling team खुद समझ जाती है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Declarative: annotation lagao, kaam ho jaaye
  • Package structure se independent
  • Readable: method dekh kar pata chal jaata hai kya lagega
Q116

How do you create a custom annotation, and what do @Target, @Retention and @Documented do?

Main Definition

  • A custom annotation is declared with @interface.
  • A marker annotation has no attributes, while a configured annotation has attributes with defaults, such as long warnAfter() default 2000.
  • @Target(ElementType.METHOD) limits where it can be used, @Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME) keeps it available at runtime, which Spring AOP requires, and @Documented includes it in JavaDoc.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Annotation बनाने के लिए class या interface की जगह @interface लिखते हैं।
  • @Target बताता है annotation कहाँ लग सकती है, और @Retention(RUNTIME) ज़रूरी है ताकि runtime पर Spring उसे देख सके।
  • RUNTIME नहीं दिया तो aspect कभी trigger नहीं होगा।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Meta-annotationValuesMatlab
@TargetMETHOD, TYPE, FIELD, PARAMETERKahan lag sakti hai; na do to almost har jagah allowed
@RetentionSOURCESirf source code mein, compiler hata deta hai (jaise @Override)
@RetentionCLASS (default).class file mein, runtime par JVM nahi deta
@RetentionRUNTIMERuntime par reflection se milti hai: AOP ke liye zaroori
@Documented-JavaDoc mein dikhe
@Target(ElementType.METHOD)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Documented
public @interface TrackExecutionTime {
    long warnAfter() default 2000;   // ms threshold
    String operation() default "";   // operation ka naam
}
Dhyan do@Retention bhool gaye to default CLASS hota hai, aur aspect bina kisi error ke chupchap kabhi nahi chalega.
Q117

Build the @TrackExecutionTime aspect that warns about slow operations.

Main Definition

  • The aspect uses @Around("@annotation(trackExecutionTime)") and receives both the ProceedingJoinPoint and the annotation instance.
  • It starts a timer, calls pjp.proceed() and returns the result, and in finally it computes the duration.
  • It reads operation() (falling back to the method name) and warnAfter(), and prints a SLOW OPERATION ALERT if the threshold is crossed.
  • Service methods use it like @TrackExecutionTime(warnAfter = 1500, operation = "Get Student Data").

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Aspect में @Around से timer शुरू करो, proceed() से method चलाओ और finally में time निकालो।
  • Annotation से operation का नाम और warnAfter threshold पढ़ो, time ज़्यादा हो तो SLOW alert print करो।
  • Service method पर हर बार अलग threshold दे सकते हो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
@Aspect
@Component
public class PerformanceAspect {

    @Around("@annotation(trackExecutionTime)")   // binding form
    public Object measure(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp, TrackExecutionTime trackExecutionTime)
            throws Throwable {
        long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
        try {
            return pjp.proceed();
        } finally {
            long duration = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;
            String op = trackExecutionTime.operation();
            if (op.isBlank()) op = pjp.getSignature().getName();
            if (duration >= trackExecutionTime.warnAfter()) {
                System.out.println("SLOW OPERATION ALERT! " + op + ": " + duration + " ms");
            } else {
                System.out.println("Time taken by " + op + ": " + duration + " ms");
            }
        }
    }
}

@Service
public class StudentService {
    @TrackExecutionTime(warnAfter = 1500, operation = "Get Student Data")
    public String getStudent(String data) throws InterruptedException {
        Thread.sleep(2000);                  // slow -> ALERT
        return "All Student Data";
    }

    @TrackExecutionTime(warnAfter = 2000, operation = "Creating New Student")
    public StudentDTO createStudent(StudentDTO student) {
        System.out.println("Student Saved");
        return student;
    }
}
Q118

What is the difference between the type-matching form and the parameter-binding form of @annotation?

Main Definition

  • In the type-matching form you write the annotation's fully-qualified name, @annotation(in.codearmy.annotation.TrackExecutionTime), and only get the join point.
  • In the binding form you write a parameter name, @annotation(trackTimeAttr), and declare a parameter of the annotation type with exactly that name in the advice.
  • Spring then injects the annotation instance, so you can read attributes like warnAfter() directly.
  • The binding form is recommended when the annotation has attributes.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Type matching में annotation का पूरा package वाला नाम लिखते हो, बस match होता है।
  • Binding form में parameter का नाम लिखते हो और advice method में उसी नाम का parameter रखते हो, तो annotation object हाथ में आ जाता है।
  • नाम एक जैसा न हो तो startup पर error आती है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
// 1. Type matching
@Around("@annotation(in.codearmy.annotation.TrackExecutionTime)")
public Object measure(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp) throws Throwable { ... }

// 2. Binding (recommended)
@Around("@annotation(trackTimeAttr)")
public Object measure(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp, TrackExecutionTime trackTimeAttr) throws Throwable {
    long threshold = trackTimeAttr.warnAfter();
    ...
}
Q119

When and how does Spring create the AOP proxy during the bean lifecycle? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • At startup Spring reads bean definitions, instantiates the bean, injects dependencies and runs init callbacks like @PostConstruct.
  • Then the AOP BeanPostProcessor (an auto-proxy creator) runs postProcessAfterInitialization, checks whether any pointcut matches the bean's methods, and if so returns a proxy (CGLIB or JDK) that replaces the original bean in the context.
  • Every bean that autowires StudentService receives the proxy.
  • Spring also caches which advice applies to which method, so runtime matching is cheap.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Bean बनने, dependencies inject होने और @PostConstruct चलने के बाद BeanPostProcessor का postProcessAfterInitialization चलता है।
  • अगर किसी aspect का pointcut उस bean पर match करे तो वो असली bean की जगह proxy रख देता है।
  • इसलिए controller में जो StudentService inject होती है वो असल में proxy होती है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Bean definitions→Instantiate→Inject deps→@PostConstruct→BeanPostProcessor (after init)→Proxy replaces bean
Step by step
  1. IoC container StudentService ka original (target) object banata hai.
  2. Dependencies inject hoti hain aur @PostConstruct jaise init callbacks chalte hain.
  3. postProcessAfterInitialization trigger hota hai.
  4. Saare aspects check hote hain: kya StudentService ke kisi method par koi pointcut (jaise @TrackExecutionTime) match karta hai?
  5. YES: proxy (CGLIB/JDK) banakar ApplicationContext mein original ki jagah rakha jaata hai. NO: original bean hi rehta hai.
  6. StudentController mein autowire hone par proxy milta hai, isliye har call advice se hokar jaati hai.
Performance

Startup par hi Spring aspects/pointcuts ko scan karke method-to-advice mapping cache kar leta hai. Runtime par har call par saare aspects dobara search nahi hote, isliye overhead bahut kam rehta hai.

public interface BeanPostProcessor {
    default Object postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object bean, String beanName) { return bean; }
    default Object postProcessAfterInitialization(Object bean, String beanName) { return bean; }
}

20. Raw JDBC

9 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Pichle topic mein humne custom annotations aur AOP dekha: ek annotation lagao, proxy beech mein aakar kaam kar deta hai. Ab tak hamari app ka data sirf memory mein tha. App band, data gayab. Ab sawaal ye hai ki Java app database se baat kaise kare? Shuruaat sabse neeche wali layer se: raw JDBC.
📖 Notes

Problem: Java aur database alag duniya hain

Socho tumhari Student app JVM mein chal rahi hai aur MySQL kisi doosre server par. Dono network par baat karte hain. Ab har database vendor (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) ke apne rules hain: connection kaise bane, login kaise ho, SQL kaise bheji jaaye, data types, errors, transactions.

Agar har vendor ke liye alag code likhna pade to database badalte hi poori app dobara likhni padegi. Yahan problem kya hai? Ek common language chahiye jo Java code aur kisi bhi database ke beech kaam kare.

Solution: JDBC = interfaces + driver

JDBC (Java Database Connectivity) java.sql package ki standard API hai. Isme sirf interfaces hain: Connection, Statement, PreparedStatement, ResultSet. Inko implement karta hai vendor ka driver (jaise mysql-connector-j). Bilkul Collection jaisa: List interface hai, ArrayList uski implementation. Yahan interface = java.sql, implementation = driver.

Core interfaces ek nazar mein

InterfaceKaam
ConnectionDatabase ke saath open session
StatementPlain SQL string chalata hai
PreparedStatement? placeholders wali SQL, safe aur reusable
ResultSetSELECT ke rows par cursor
<!-- pom.xml: MySQL driver -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.mysql</groupId>
    <artifactId>mysql-connector-j</artifactId>
</dependency>
Yaad rakhoJDBC 4.0+ mein driver apne aap register ho jaata hai. Purane tutorials wala Class.forName("com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver") ab zaroori nahi. Detail: Q121

Step 1: Connection banana

DriverManager.getConnection(url, username, password) ek Connection deta hai. JDBC URL mein protocol, host, port aur database ka naam hota hai: jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/student_db.

String url = "jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/student_db";
try (Connection connection = DriverManager.getConnection(url, "root", "your_password")) {
    System.out.println("Database Connected Successfully!");
} catch (SQLException e) {   // JDBC ki har galti checked SQLException hai
    e.printStackTrace();
}
Dhyan doPassword code mein hardcode karna sirf demo ke liye. Real project mein environment variable ya config use karo.

Step 2: SQL chalana — teen execute methods

MethodKis ke liyeReturn
executeUpdate()INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDLint (kitni rows affect hui)
executeQuery()SELECTResultSet
execute()Koi bhi SQLboolean (true = ResultSet mila)
boolean isResultSet = ps.execute();
if (isResultSet) {                       // SELECT tha
    try (ResultSet rs = ps.getResultSet()) { while (rs.next()) { /* rows */ } }
} else {                                 // INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE tha
    int updateCount = ps.getUpdateCount();
}

PreparedStatement: SQL injection se bachav

Socho login query string jodkar banayi: "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='" + name + "'". User ne name mein ' OR '1'='1 daal diya. Query ban gayi WHERE name='' OR '1'='1', jo hamesha true hai. Bina password ke login!

PreparedStatement mein ? placeholder hota hai aur value alag se type-safe setter se jaati hai. Database usse sirf data maanta hai, kabhi SQL nahi. Bonus: NULL, dates, binary data sahi handle hote hain aur query precompile hokar reuse hoti hai.

// Galat: user input SQL ka hissa ban gaya
String sql = "SELECT * FROM students WHERE email = '" + email + "'";

// Sahi: ? placeholder, value sirf data hai
PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
        "SELECT * FROM students WHERE email = ?");
ps.setString(1, email);       // index 1 se shuru, 0 se nahi
ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery();
Common galti? sirf values ke liye hai, table ya column naam ke liye nahi. Aur PreparedStatement banake bhi string concat kar di to bachav khatam. Index 0 se shuru karna bhi common galti hai.

Step 3: ResultSet padhna (manual mapping)

ResultSet ek cursor hai jo pehli row se pehle khada hota hai. rs.next() agli row par le jaata hai aur rows khatam hone par false deta hai. Column getString / getInt / getLong se padhte ho, naam ya 1-based index se. Ek row ho to if (rs.next()), kai rows to while (rs.next()).

private Student mapRow(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
    Student s = new Student();
    s.setId(rs.getLong("id"));
    s.setName(rs.getString("name"));
    s.setEmail(rs.getString("email"));
    s.setAge(rs.getInt("age"));
    return s;
}

while (rs.next()) {            // har row ke liye ek Student
    studentList.add(mapRow(rs));
}
Yaad rakhoYe mapping har table ke liye haath se likhni padti hai. Yahi boilerplate aage ORM automatic kar dega.

Step 4: Resources band karna — try-with-resources

Connection, PreparedStatement, ResultSet teeno AutoCloseable hain. try-with-resources (Java 7+) inhe exception aane par bhi band karta hai, aur ulte order mein: pehle ResultSet, phir PreparedStatement, phir Connection. Purana lamba finally + nested try-catch hat jaata hai.

try (Connection con = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, USER, PASS);
     PreparedStatement ps = con.prepareStatement(sql);
     ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
    // rs use karo
}   // auto close: rs -> ps -> con
Dhyan doConnection close na kiya to connection leak. Pool khaali ho jaata hai aur app hang ho sakti hai.

Step 5: Transaction — dono ya koi nahi

Bank transfer socho: A se 500 kato, B mein 500 jodo. Pehla UPDATE chala, doosre se pehle server crash. JDBC default mein auto-commit mode mein hai, matlab har statement turant commit. A ka paisa gaya, B ko mila nahi!

Fix: setAutoCommit(false) karo, saari queries chalao, sab theek ho to commit(), kuch fail ho to rollback(). Isse atomicity milti hai.

try (Connection con = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, USER, PASS)) {
    con.setAutoCommit(false);        // 1. manual transaction shuru
    try {
        debit(con, "A", 500);        // 2. step 1
        credit(con, "B", 500);       // 3. step 2
        con.commit();                // 4. sab theek: save
    } catch (SQLException e) {
        con.rollback();              // 5. kuch fail: sab undo
        throw e;
    }
}

Raw JDBC ka dard: itna boilerplate kyun?

Har query ke liye wahi kaam: connection kholo, statement banao, har ? set karo, execute karo, ResultSet ko haath se map karo, sab close karo, checked SQLException pakdo, transaction ka code likho. Business logic 2 line ki, baaki 15 line kachra. Isi dard ko alag-alag layers ne khatam kiya:

LayerKya khatam karta hai
Raw JDBCKuch nahi: sab kuch khud likhna padta hai
Spring JDBC (JdbcTemplate)Connection, Statement, close aur exception ka boilerplate
Hibernate / JPASQL likhna aur ResultSet mapping
Spring Data JPAHar entity ke liye repeat hone wala repository code
@Transactionalcommit / rollback ka manual code
📌 Yaad rakho
  • JDBC = java.sql ke interfaces; driver vendor ki implementation hai.
  • Connection → PreparedStatement → execute → ResultSet → close: yahi raw JDBC ka flow hai.
  • Hamesha PreparedStatement + ? use karo; index 1 se shuru hota hai.
  • executeUpdate = int, executeQuery = ResultSet, execute = boolean.
  • try-with-resources ulte order mein close karta hai; close na karna = connection leak.
  • Multi-step kaam: setAutoCommit(false) → commit() / rollback().

Q120

What is JDBC, and why do we need it?

Main Definition

  • JDBC (Java Database Connectivity) is the standard Java API, in the java.sql package, for talking to a relational database.
  • It defines common interfaces like Connection, Statement, PreparedStatement and ResultSet, so the same Java code works with MySQL, PostgreSQL or Oracle once the right driver is added.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • JDBC Java और database के बीच का common translator है।
  • Code सिर्फ़ java.sql के interfaces से बात करता है, MySQL हो या PostgreSQL, code वही रहता है।

  • Har vendor ke apne rules hain: connection, authentication, SQL packaging, data types, errors, transactions.
  • Collection se compare karo: Collection ek interface hai, ArrayList aur LinkedList uski implementations. Yahan interface = java.sql, implementation = driver.

Q123

What is the difference between executeUpdate(), executeQuery() and execute()?

Main Definition

  • executeUpdate() runs INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL and returns the affected row count (int).
  • executeQuery() runs SELECT and returns a ResultSet.
  • execute() is the general-purpose one and returns a boolean: true means the result is a ResultSet, false means it is an update count.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • executeUpdate() INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE के लिए है और कितनी rows बदलीं वो int देता है।
  • executeQuery() SELECT के लिए ResultSet देता है, और execute() general है जो boolean देता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
MethodKis ke liyeReturn
executeUpdate()INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDLint (rows affected)
executeQuery()SELECTResultSet
execute()Koi bhi SQLboolean (true = ResultSet)
boolean isResultSet = ps.execute();

if (isResultSet) {            // SELECT
    try (ResultSet rs = ps.getResultSet()) {
        while (rs.next()) { /* read rows */ }
    }
} else {                      // INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE
    int updateCount = ps.getUpdateCount();
}

Q124

What is the difference between Statement and PreparedStatement? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • PreparedStatement uses ? placeholders and sets values with type-safe setters, so the database treats input as data and never as SQL.
  • This prevents SQL injection, handles NULL, dates and binary data correctly, and the query can be precompiled and reused.
  • A plain Statement built with string concatenation or String.format() gives none of this.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • PreparedStatement में ?
  • placeholder लगते हैं और value setter से जाती है, इसलिए user input कभी SQL नहीं बनता।
  • इससे SQL injection रुकता है और query precompile होकर reuse भी होती है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Story: login form par SQL injection

Socho login query string jodkar banayi: "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='" + name + "'". User ne name mein ' OR '1'='1 daal diya. Ab query ban gayi WHERE name='' OR '1'='1' jo hamesha true hai, aur bina password ke login ho gaya.

Statement vs PreparedStatement code
// Galat: input SQL ka hissa ban jaata hai
Statement st = con.createStatement();
st.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='" + name + "'");

// Sahi: ? placeholder, value sirf data hai
PreparedStatement ps = con.prepareStatement("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?");
ps.setString(1, name);
ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery();
Common mistakes
  • Table ya column name ko ? se bind karne ki koshish: ? sirf values ke liye hai.
  • PreparedStatement banaya par phir bhi string concat kar di.
  • Index 0 se shuru kiya: setString ka index 1 se shuru hota hai.
  • Parameter index 1 se shuru hota hai, 0 se nahi.
  • Setters: setString, setInt, setLong, setNull.
  • Plain Statement ki dikkatein: NULL handling, binary data, date syntax, kharab readability, SQL injection.
// Unsafe: user input becomes part of the SQL
String sql = "SELECT * FROM students WHERE email = '" + email + "'";

// Safe: ? placeholder, value set separately
String sql = "SELECT * FROM students WHERE email = ?";
PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql);
ps.setString(1, email);   // index starts at 1
Interview line'I always use PreparedStatement with ? placeholders and never concatenate user input into SQL.'

Q125

How does ResultSet work?

Main Definition

  • A ResultSet is a cursor over the rows a SELECT returns.
  • It starts before the first row.
  • rs.next() moves to the next row and returns false when there are no more rows.
  • I read columns with getString / getInt / getLong by column name or 1-based index, and usually keep the mapping in a mapRow() helper.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • ResultSet एक cursor है जो पहली row से पहले खड़ा होता है।
  • हर rs.next() उसे अगली row पर ले जाता है और rows ख़त्म होने पर false देता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Ek row: if (rs.next()). Kai rows: while (rs.next()).
  • Ye manual mapping boilerplate hai. ORM isi ko automatic kar deta hai.
private Student mapRow(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
    Student student = new Student();
    student.setId(rs.getLong("id"));
    student.setName(rs.getString("name"));
    student.setEmail(rs.getString("email"));
    student.setAge(rs.getInt("age"));
    return student;
}

while (rs.next()) {              // many rows
    studentList.add(mapRow(rs));
}

Q126

Why do we use try-with-resources in JDBC?

Main Definition

  • try-with-resources (Java 7+) automatically closes anything that implements AutoCloseable, such as Connection, PreparedStatement and ResultSet, even when an exception occurs.
  • Resources close in reverse order: ResultSet, then PreparedStatement, then Connection.
  • It replaces the verbose finally block with nested try-catch.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • try-with-resources ResultSet, Statement और Connection को अपने आप close करता है, exception आए तब भी।
  • ये ऐसा है जैसे कमरे से निकलते ही light automatic बंद हो जाए।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
try (Connection connection = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD);
     PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql);
     ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
    // use rs
}   // closed automatically: rs -> ps -> connection
Dhyan doConnection close na karne se connection leak hota hai. Connection pool khatam ho jaata hai aur app hang ho sakti hai.
ReferenceOracle JDBC Tutorial
Q127

How do transactions work in plain JDBC? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • By default JDBC runs in auto-commit mode, so every statement commits immediately.
  • For a multi-step operation I call connection.setAutoCommit(false), run all statements, then commit() if all succeed or rollback() if any fails.
  • This gives atomicity: all steps happen, or none do.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • JDBC default में auto-commit पर चलता है, हर statement तुरंत save।
  • कई steps को एक साथ रखने के लिए setAutoCommit(false), फिर सब ठीक हो तो commit() वरना rollback()।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Story: bank transfer

Account A se 500 kato aur B mein 500 jodo. Pehla UPDATE chala, doosre se pehle server crash. Auto-commit mein A ka paisa gaya aur B ko mila nahi. Transaction ka matlab: dono ya koi nahi.

Code step by step
try (Connection con = ds.getConnection()) {
    con.setAutoCommit(false);          // 1. transaction shuru
    try {
        debit(con, "A", 500);          // 2. step 1
        credit(con, "B", 500);         // 3. step 2
        con.commit();                  // 4. sab theek: save
    } catch (SQLException e) {
        con.rollback();                // 5. kuch fail: sab undo
        throw e;
    }
}
Yaad rakhoSpring mein yahi kaam @Transactional karta hai (Q166), tumhe setAutoCommit / commit / rollback khud nahi likhna padta.
try (Connection connection = DriverManager.getConnection(URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD)) {
    connection.setAutoCommit(false);        // 1. start manual transaction
    try {
        // Query 1: deduct from A
        // Query 2: credit to B
        connection.commit();                // 2. all good
    } catch (Exception e) {
        connection.rollback();              // 3. undo everything
    }
} catch (SQLException e) {
    e.printStackTrace();
}
ReferenceJDBC Transactions (Oracle)

What are the limits of raw JDBC, and what comes after it?

Main Definition

  • Raw JDBC needs a lot of boilerplate: opening and closing connections, writing SQL by hand, setting every ? parameter, manually mapping each ResultSet row to an object and writing transaction code.
  • That is why projects move to Spring JDBC (JdbcTemplate), Hibernate (ORM) and Spring Data JPA with @Transactional.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Raw JDBC में हर query के लिए connection, parameters, mapping, close और exception का same code बार-बार लिखना पड़ता है।
  • इसी दर्द को हटाने के लिए Spring JDBC और ORM आए।

21. Spring JDBC, JdbcTemplate aur HikariCP

7 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Raw JDBC mein humne dekha ki 2 line ke kaam ke liye 15 line boilerplate likhni padti hai, aur har baar naya connection banana mehnga hai. Ab dekhte hain Spring isme kya badalta hai: Spring JDBC, JdbcTemplate aur HikariCP connection pool.
📖 Notes

Problem: har query mein wahi 6 steps

Raw JDBC mein har method mein ye repeat hota hai: (1) connection kholo, (2) statement banao, (3) parameters set karo, (4) execute karo, (5) close karo, (6) SQLException sambhalo. Inme se zyadatar static hai, har query mein same. Badalta sirf SQL, values aur row mapping hai.

Static (Spring sambhalta hai)Dynamic (tum likhte ho)
Connection kholna aur manage karnaSQL query
PreparedStatement bananaQuery ke parameters
Connection aur Statement close karnaResultSet → Java object (RowMapper)
SQLException ko catch karke translate karnaBusiness logic
Yaad rakhoSpring JDBC JDBC ko replace nahi karta, uske upar ek patla wrapper hai. Andar wahi JDBC chalta hai.

Solution: JdbcTemplate (Template Design Pattern)

Chai banane ka fixed tareeka hai: paani ubaalo, patti daalo, chhaano. Bas flavour (adrak, elaichi) badalta hai. Template pattern yahi hai: fixed algorithm ek baar likha, badalne wale hisse bahar se do.

JdbcTemplate Spring JDBC ki central class hai. Fixed steps Spring ke, flavour (SQL, parameters, RowMapper) tumhara.

Raw JDBC vs JdbcTemplate

KaamRaw JDBCJdbcTemplate
Connection lena / chhodnaTumSpring (pool se)
PreparedStatement bananaTumSpring
Parameters bindTum (setX)Spring (varargs se)
Row ko object bananaTum (loop)Tumhara RowMapper
SQLException handleTum (try/catch)Spring: unchecked DataAccessException
SQL likhnaTumTum
// Raw JDBC mein ~15 lines, yahan ek statement
Student s = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
    "SELECT id, name FROM students WHERE id = ?",
    (rs, rowNum) -> new Student(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("name")),
    id);

Connection pool: naya connection mehnga kyun?

Ek physical DB connection banane mein TCP handshake, authentication aur session setup lagta hai. Har request par ye karna = slow app.

Taxi stand socho: har customer ke liye nayi taxi khareedna bewakoofi hai. Stand par 10 taxiyan khadi hain: customer aaya, taxi li, kaam karke wapas stand par chhod di. Connection pool yahi hai. Aur pool wale connection par close() taxi ko wapas stand bhejta hai, todta nahi.

Pool andar se kaise kaam karta hai

  1. App start par pool kuch connections pehle se bana leta hai.
  2. Request aayi: thread pool se ek connection borrow karta hai.
  3. Query chali, kaam khatam.
  4. close() call hua: connection pool mein wapas gaya, physical connection zinda hai.
  5. Sab connections busy hain to naya request connection-timeout tak wait karta hai, phir exception.
Real exampleHikariCP Spring Boot ka default pool hai. spring-boot-starter-jdbc (aur spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, jo isi ko andar laata hai) ke saath apne aap aata hai.

DataSource aur auto-configuration

javax.sql.DataSource connection dene ka standard JDBC interface hai. Boot mein uski implementation HikariDataSource hai. Boot classpath par spring-boot-starter-jdbc aur driver dekhta hai, spring.datasource.* properties padhta hai, HikariDataSource bean banata hai aur uske upar JdbcTemplate bean bhi. Tumhe bas inject karna hai.

<!-- pom.xml (version Boot parent se) -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-jdbc</artifactId>
</dependency>

# application.properties
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/student_db
spring.datasource.username=root
spring.datasource.password=${DB_PASSWORD}     # env variable se lo

# optional HikariCP tuning
spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size=10
spring.datasource.hikari.connection-timeout=30000

Important HikariCP properties

Property (spring.datasource.hikari.*)MatlabDefault
maximum-pool-sizeMax connections10
minimum-idleKam se kam khaali connectionsmax ke barabar
connection-timeoutConnection ke liye kitna wait (ms)30000
idle-timeoutKhaali connection kab band (ms)600000
max-lifetimeConnection ki max umar (ms)1800000
Common galtiPool bahut bada kar dena se speed nahi badhti, DB par load badhta hai. Lambi @Transactional method mein HTTP call karna bhi galat: connection der tak pakda rehta hai aur baaki requests timeout hoti hain.

JdbcTemplate ke 3 main methods

MethodKaamReturn
update(sql, params...)INSERT, UPDATE, DELETEint (affected rows)
query(sql, rowMapper, params...)SELECT, kai rowsList<T>
queryForObject(sql, rowMapper, params...)SELECT, sirf 1 rowT
@Repository
public class StudentRepository {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
    private final RowMapper<Student> rowMapper =
            new BeanPropertyRowMapper<>(Student.class);

    public StudentRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate) {   // constructor injection
        this.jdbcTemplate = jdbcTemplate;
    }

    public int createStudent(Student s) {
        return jdbcTemplate.update(
            "INSERT INTO students (name, email, age) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            s.getName(), s.getEmail(), s.getAge());
    }

    public int deleteStudent(Long id) {
        return jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM students WHERE id = ?", id);
    }

    public List<Student> getAllStudents() {
        return jdbcTemplate.query("SELECT id, name, email, age FROM students", rowMapper);
    }

    public Student getStudentById(Long id) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
            "SELECT id, name, email, age FROM students WHERE id = ?", rowMapper, id);
    }
}
Dhyan doqueryForObject ko 0 row mile to wo null nahi deta, EmptyResultDataAccessException phenkta hai. 1 se zyada mile to IncorrectResultSizeDataAccessException. 'Shayad na mile' wale case mein query(...) se list lo aur stream().findFirst() karo.

RowMapper: ek row → ek object

RowMapper<T> ek functional interface hai jiska ek method hai mapRow(ResultSet rs, int rowNum). JdbcTemplate har row ke liye isse call karta hai. BeanPropertyRowMapper ready-made automatic mapper hai: column naam ko bean property se match karta hai, full_name → fullName bhi.

// Manual: poora control (lambda bhi chalega)
public class StudentRowMapper implements RowMapper<Student> {
    @Override
    public Student mapRow(ResultSet rs, int rowNum) throws SQLException {
        Student s = new Student();
        s.setId(rs.getLong("id"));
        s.setName(rs.getString("name"));
        return s;
    }
}

// Automatic: naam match hon to
RowMapper<Student> auto = new BeanPropertyRowMapper<>(Student.class);
Yaad rakhoBeanPropertyRowMapper ko default constructor aur setters chahiye, aur ye reflection se chalta hai (thoda slow). Hot path par manual mapper behtar.

Exception translation: SQLException → DataAccessException

Raw JDBC ka SQLException checked hai aur uske error codes har vendor mein alag. Spring use unchecked DataAccessException family mein badal deta hai, jo database-independent aur meaningful hai. Ab sirf wahi pakdo jo tumhe chahiye.

ExceptionKab aata hai
DuplicateKeyExceptionUNIQUE / PK violation (same email dobara)
DataIntegrityViolationExceptionFK ya NOT NULL violation
BadSqlGrammarExceptionSQL syntax ya column naam galat
EmptyResultDataAccessExceptionqueryForObject ko 0 rows
IncorrectResultSizeDataAccessExceptionqueryForObject ko 1 se zyada rows
CannotGetJdbcConnectionExceptionDB down ya pool khatam
Dhyan doDuplicateKeyException asal mein DataIntegrityViolationException ki subclass hai, isliye catch mein specific wali pehle. Aur ye unchecked hain, to @Transactional inpar default rollback karta hai.
📌 Yaad rakho
  • Spring JDBC = JDBC ke upar wrapper; SQL tum likhte ho, baaki Spring.
  • JdbcTemplate = Template pattern: fixed steps Spring ke, SQL + params + RowMapper tumhare.
  • Pool wale connection par close() = wapas pool mein. Boot ka default pool HikariCP (max 10).
  • update → int, query → List, queryForObject → ek object (0 rows par exception, null nahi).
  • RowMapper ek row ko object banata hai; BeanPropertyRowMapper naam match karke automatic.
  • SQLException (checked, vendor-specific) → DataAccessException (unchecked, common).

✅ Review questions (7): ab khud check karo

Q129

Why Spring JDBC when we already have raw JDBC? What problem does it solve?

Main Definition

  • Raw JDBC makes you repeat the same boilerplate for every query: open a Connection, create a PreparedStatement, bind the parameters, execute, map the ResultSet, close the resources and handle the checked SQLException.
  • Spring JDBC is a thin abstraction layer over JDBC that handles all these static parts, so you only write the SQL, the parameters and the row mapping.
  • It does not replace JDBC, it wraps it.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Spring JDBC raw JDBC का boilerplate (connection खोलना, close करना, SQLException पकड़ना) अपने पास ले लेता है।
  • SQL अभी भी तुम लिखते हो, बाकी का बार-बार वाला काम Spring करता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Static (Spring sambhalta hai)Dynamic (tum likhte ho)
Connection kholna aur manage karnaSQL query
PreparedStatement bananaQuery ke parameters (values)
Connection aur Statement close karnaResultSet ko Java object mein map karna (RowMapper)
Checked SQLException ko catch karke translate karnaBusiness logic
  • Raw JDBC ke 6 repeated steps: connection, statement, parameters, execute, close, exception handling.
  • Spring JDBC ka maksad raw JDBC ko khatam karna nahi, uske upar wrapper lagakar boilerplate hatana hai.
  • Developer sirf business logic aur SQL par dhyan deta hai.
ReferenceSpring Framework: Data access with JDBC
Q130

How does JdbcTemplate work internally? Which design pattern does it use? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • JdbcTemplate is the central class of Spring JDBC and follows the Template Design Pattern: the fixed algorithm (borrow a Connection from the pool, create the PreparedStatement, bind parameters, execute, map the ResultSet, release resources, translate the SQLException) is implemented once by Spring, while the varying parts (the SQL, the parameters and the RowMapper) are supplied by the developer.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • JdbcTemplate Template pattern use करता है: fixed steps (connection लेना, statement बनाना, execute, close) Spring के पास हैं।
  • तुम सिर्फ़ बदलने वाला हिस्सा देते हो: SQL, parameters और RowMapper।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Template pattern ko aise samjho

Chai banane ka fixed tareeka hai: paani ubaalo, patti daalo, chhaano. Bas flavour (adrak, elaichi) badalta hai. JdbcTemplate mein fixed steps Spring ke hain, flavour (SQL, parameters, RowMapper) tumhara.

Raw JDBC vs JdbcTemplate
KaamRaw JDBCJdbcTemplate
Connection lena/chhodnaTumSpring
PreparedStatement bananaTumSpring
Parameters bindTum (setX)Spring (varargs se)
Row ko object bananaTum (loop)Tumhara RowMapper
SQLException handleTum (try/catch)Spring: DataAccessException
SQL likhnaTumTum
Same query JdbcTemplate se
// Raw JDBC mein ~15 lines, yahan ek statement
Student s = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
    "SELECT id, name FROM students WHERE id = ?",
    (rs, rowNum) -> new Student(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("name")),
    id);
Extra (mera note)spring-boot-starter-jdbc ke saath JdbcTemplate ka bean Spring Boot khud bana deta hai. Bas constructor mein inject kar lo.

Important 44 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q127)★ Important listAgla important (Q131) → ★
Q131

What is connection pooling, and what is HikariCP? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • Opening a physical database connection is expensive: a TCP handshake, authentication and session setup.
  • A connection pool keeps a set of pre-created, reusable connections.
  • The application borrows one, uses it, and close() returns it to the pool instead of closing the physical connection.
  • If every connection is busy, new requests wait until a timeout.
  • HikariCP is the fast, production-grade pool that Spring Boot uses by default.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • हर बार नया DB connection बनाना महँगा है, जैसे हर ride के लिए नई car खरीदना।
  • Connection pool पहले से बने connections रखता है, HikariCP Spring Boot का default fast pool है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Story: taxi stand

Har customer ke liye nayi taxi khareedna (naya connection: TCP handshake, auth, session) bahut mehnga hai. Taxi stand par 10 taxiyan khadi hain: customer aaya, taxi li, kaam karke wapas stand par chhod di. Pool yahi hai, aur close() taxi ko wapas stand bhejta hai, todta nahi.

Important HikariCP properties
Property (spring.datasource.hikari.*)MatlabDefault
maximum-pool-sizeMax connections10
minimum-idleKam se kam khaali connectionsmax ke barabar
connection-timeoutConnection ke liye kitna wait (ms)30000
idle-timeoutKhaali connection kab band (ms)600000
max-lifetimeConnection ki max umar (ms)1800000
Common mistakes
  • Pool size bahut bada rakhna: DB par load badhta hai, speed nahi.
  • Connection close na karna: pool khaali, baaki requests connection-timeout par fail.
  • Lambi @Transactional methods mein HTTP call karna: connection der tak pakda rehta hai.
  • Borrow: kaam shuru karte waqt pool se connection lo.
  • close() ka matlab pool mein wapas, physical connection band nahi hota.
  • Sab connections busy hon to naya request timeout tak wait karta hai.
  • spring-boot-starter-jdbc ke saath HikariCP default milta hai (spring-boot-starter-data-jpa ke andar bhi ye aata hai).
Extra (mera note)HikariCP ka default maximum-pool-size 10 hota hai. Pool badi karne se speed apne aap nahi badhti, pehle database ki connection limit dekho.
ReferenceHikariCP (GitHub)Spring Framework: Data access with JDBC

Q132

What is a DataSource, and how does Spring Boot configure it?

Main Definition

  • DataSource (javax.sql.DataSource) is the standard JDBC interface for obtaining Connections.
  • With Spring Boot the implementation is HikariCP's HikariDataSource.
  • Boot's auto-configuration detects spring-boot-starter-jdbc and the database driver on the classpath, reads the spring.datasource.* properties from application.properties, creates a HikariDataSource bean and registers it in the IoC container.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • DataSource connections देने वाला standard interface है।
  • Spring Boot properties पढ़कर अपने आप HikariDataSource bean बना देता है, खुद कुछ configure नहीं करना पड़ता।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  1. Classpath mein spring-boot-starter-jdbc aur database driver (jaise mysql-connector-j) milta hai.
  2. application.properties se spring.datasource.* values padhta hai.
  3. HikariDataSource ka bean banakar IoC container mein register kar deta hai.
<!-- pom.xml (version Spring Boot parent se aata hai) -->
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-jdbc</artifactId>
</dependency>

# application.properties
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/student_db
spring.datasource.username=root
spring.datasource.password=123456

# optional HikariCP tuning

spring.datasource.hikari.idle-timeout=30000
Extra (mera note)Real project mein password properties file mein hardcode mat karo. Environment variable ya secrets manager use karo.

Q133

Which JdbcTemplate methods do you use for insert, update, delete and select?

Main Definition

  • update(sql, params...) runs INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE and returns the affected row count as an int.
  • query(sql, rowMapper) runs a SELECT that returns many rows as a List<T>.
  • queryForObject(sql, rowMapper, params...) runs a SELECT that is expected to return exactly one row as a single object.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • update() INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE चलाकर affected rows देता है।
  • query() कई rows की List देता है और queryForObject() सिर्फ़ एक row या एक value देता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
MethodKaamReturn type
update(sql, params...)INSERT, UPDATE, DELETEint (affected rows)
query(sql, rowMapper)SELECT, kai rowsList<T>
queryForObject(sql, rowMapper, params...)SELECT, sirf 1 rowT (single object)
  • SQL mein ? placeholders aur alag se params dete ho, isliye PreparedStatement bante hain aur SQL injection se bachav hota hai.
  • JdbcTemplate ko constructor injection se lo.
@Repository
public class StudentRepository {

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
    private final RowMapper<Student> rowMapper;

    public StudentRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate) {
        this.jdbcTemplate = jdbcTemplate;
        this.rowMapper = new BeanPropertyRowMapper<>(Student.class);
    }

    public int createStudent(Student s) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO students (name, email, age) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
        return jdbcTemplate.update(sql, s.getName(), s.getEmail(), s.getAge());
    }

    public int updateStudent(Student s) {
        String sql = "UPDATE students SET name = ?, email = ?, age = ? WHERE id = ?";
        return jdbcTemplate.update(sql, s.getName(), s.getEmail(), s.getAge(), s.getId());
    }

    public int deleteStudent(Long id) {
        return jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM students WHERE id = ?", id);
    }

    public List<Student> getAllStudents() {
        return jdbcTemplate.query("SELECT id, name, email, age FROM students", rowMapper);
    }

    public Student getStudentById(Long id) {
        String sql = "SELECT id, name, email, age FROM students WHERE id = ?";
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(sql, rowMapper, id);
    }
}
Dhyan doqueryForObject mein row na mile to null nahi milta, EmptyResultDataAccessException aata hai.
ReferenceSpring Framework: Data access with JDBC
Q134

What is a RowMapper, and when do you use BeanPropertyRowMapper?

Main Definition

  • RowMapper<T> is a functional interface with a single method, mapRow(ResultSet rs, int rowNum), that converts one row of the ResultSet into a Java object.
  • JdbcTemplate calls it for every row.
  • BeanPropertyRowMapper is a ready-made automatic RowMapper that matches column names to bean properties, including snake_case to camelCase (full_name to fullName), so you can skip the manual mapper when the names line up.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • RowMapper ResultSet की एक row को Java object में बदलता है और JdbcTemplate उसे हर row के लिए call करता है।
  • BeanPropertyRowMapper column names को field names से खुद match कर देता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
// Manual mapping: poora control
public class StudentRowMapper implements RowMapper<Student> {
    @Override
    public Student mapRow(ResultSet rs, int rowNum) throws SQLException {
        Student s = new Student();
        s.setId(rs.getLong("id"));
        s.setName(rs.getString("name"));
        s.setEmail(rs.getString("email"));
        s.setAge(rs.getInt("age"));
        return s;
    }
}

// Automatic mapping: column naam aur field naam match hon
RowMapper<Student> rowMapper = new BeanPropertyRowMapper<>(Student.class);
Extra (mera note)BeanPropertyRowMapper ko class mein default constructor aur setters chahiye hote hain, aur ye reflection se kaam karta hai.
ReferenceSpring Framework: Data access with JDBC
Q135

How does Spring JDBC handle SQLException? What is DataAccessException?

Main Definition

  • Raw JDBC throws a checked, vendor-specific SQLException that must be caught everywhere, and its error codes differ across MySQL, PostgreSQL and Oracle.
  • Spring JDBC performs exception translation: it converts it into the unchecked DataAccessException hierarchy, whose subclasses are meaningful and database-independent, so you catch only the errors you care about.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Raw JDBC का SQLException checked और हर database के लिए अलग होता है।
  • Spring उसे unchecked DataAccessException family (जैसे DuplicateKeyException) में बदल देता है, जो हर DB के लिए same है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
ExceptionKab aata hai
DuplicateKeyExceptionUNIQUE ya PRIMARY KEY violation, jaise same email dobara insert
DataIntegrityViolationExceptionForeign key ya NOT NULL constraint violation
BadSqlGrammarExceptionSQL syntax ya column naam galat
EmptyResultDataAccessExceptionqueryForObject ko 0 rows mile
IncorrectResultSizeDataAccessExceptionqueryForObject ko 1 se zyada rows mile
CannotGetJdbcConnectionExceptionDatabase down ya connection pool khatam
Translation examples
DB errorSpring exception
Duplicate primary/unique keyDuplicateKeyException
FK violationDataIntegrityViolationException
queryForObject par 0 rowsEmptyResultDataAccessException
Connection nahi milaCannotGetJdbcConnectionException
Galat SQL syntaxBadSqlGrammarException
  • Parent: DataAccessException (unchecked). Isliye try-catch zaruri nahi.
  • Vendor ka alag error code ek hi exception type mein badal jaata hai.
Extra (mera note)DuplicateKeyException asal mein DataIntegrityViolationException ki subclass hai, aur EmptyResultDataAccessException, IncorrectResultSizeDataAccessException ki. Catch karte waqt pehle specific wali rakho. Ye exceptions unchecked hain, isliye @Transactional par default rollback bhi hota hai (@Transactional wala chapter dekho).

22. ORM, JPA aur Hibernate

3 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: JdbcTemplate ne connection aur close ka dard hata diya, par SQL aur RowMapper abhi bhi haath se likhne padte hain. 50 tables hain to 50 mappers. Ab sawaal: kya Java class dekhkar SQL khud ban sakti hai? Yahin aata hai ORM.
📖 Notes

Problem: Object world vs Table world

Java mein hum objects, references, inheritance, polymorphism mein sochte hain. Database mein tables, rows, primary key, foreign key aur normalization hai. Dono ko jodna hamesha translation maangta hai. Is takraav ko Object-Relational Impedance Mismatch kehte hain.

Java (object world)Database (relational world)
ClassTable
Field / propertyColumn
Heap mein ek objectEk row
Reference (student.department)Foreign key (department_id)
Inheritance, polymorphismPK, FK, normalization

Solution: ORM

ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) ek baar mapping batao (class → table, field → column), phir wo khud karta hai:

  • INSERT, UPDATE, SELECT, DELETE ki SQL automatic banana.
  • Parameter binding aur ResultSet → object mapping automatic.
  • Relationships (one-to-many, embedded) handle karna.
  • Caching se DB calls kam karna.
  • Transaction manager ke saath integrate hona.

JPA vs Hibernate vs JDBC — teen naam, teen kaam

JPA (Jakarta Persistence API) ek specification hai: sirf rules, interfaces aur annotations (@Entity, @Id, EntityManager). Iska khud ka koi code nahi chalta.

Hibernate ek ORM framework hai jo JPA ko implement karta hai. Spring Boot mein default implementation yahi hai.

JDBC wahi low-level API hai jo Hibernate andar se DB se baat karne ke liye use karta hai. Matlab JDBC gaya nahi, bas tumhe dikhta nahi.

Comparison table

JDBCJPAHibernate
Kya haiLow-level APISpecification (rules)Framework (implementation)
Packagejava.sqljakarta.persistenceorg.hibernate
SQL kaun likhta haiTum—Hibernate generate karta hai
Spring ke bina chalega?HaanHaanHaan
Dhyan doSpring Boot 3 mein package jakarta.persistence hai, purana javax.persistence nahi (wo Boot 2 tak tha). Purane tutorials se copy karte waqt import check karo.

Flow: tumhara code se DB tak

Tumhara Service→Spring Data JPA Repository→JPA (EntityManager)→Hibernate (Session)→JDBC + HikariCP→MySQL

Setup: dependency + application.properties

<dependency>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>  <!-- Hibernate + HikariCP + JDBC sab -->
</dependency>

# application.properties
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/student_db
spring.datasource.username=root
spring.datasource.password=${DB_PASSWORD}

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update                # schema kaise bane
spring.jpa.show-sql=true                            # Hibernate ki SQL console mein
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.format_sql=true     # SQL sundar format mein

ddl-auto ke options

ddl-autoKya hota hai
updateEntity ke hisaab se schema badhata hai, data nahi udaata
createHar startup par tables drop karke naye (data loss)
create-dropStartup par create, shutdown par drop (tests)
validateSirf match check, mismatch par startup fail
noneKuch nahi; production mein Flyway / Liquibase se migration
Common galtiProduction mein create ya update mat rakho. create poora data uda dega, update column kabhi drop/rename nahi karta aur galat schema chhod sakta hai. Production: validate ya none + migrations.

Console mein kya dikhega

show-sql on karne par Hibernate jo SQL bhejta hai wo console mein aati hai. Aage har topic mein hum yahi dekhenge ki Java code ke peeche kaunsi SQL chali:

Hibernate:
    insert
    into
        students
        (age, email, student_name)
    values
        (?, ?, ?)
Yaad rakhoValues ? dikhti hain kyunki Hibernate bhi andar PreparedStatement hi use karta hai. Values dekhni hon to logging.level.org.hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind=TRACE (Hibernate 6).
📌 Yaad rakho
  • ORM = class ↔ table, field ↔ column, object ↔ row; SQL khud banti hai.
  • Impedance mismatch = object world aur relational world ka farak.
  • JPA = specification, Hibernate = implementation, JDBC = andar ki low-level API.
  • Boot 3 mein jakarta.persistence, javax nahi.
  • show-sql + format_sql se generated SQL dekho; production mein ddl-auto validate/none.

Q136

What is ORM, and what is the Object-Relational Impedance Mismatch?

Main Definition

  • ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) maps Java classes to tables, fields to columns and objects to rows, and generates the SQL automatically.
  • It solves the Object-Relational Impedance Mismatch: the object world (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, references) and the relational world (tables, primary and foreign keys, normalization) are modelled very differently.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • ORM Java classes को tables से और objects को rows से जोड़ता है और SQL खुद बनाता है।
  • Object world (inheritance, references) और table world (rows, foreign keys) का mismatch यही handle करता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Java (object world)Database (relational world)
ClassTable
Field / propertyColumn
Object in heap memoryRow
Inheritance, polymorphismPrimary key, foreign key, normalization
  • Metadata mapping: class se table, property se column.
  • Automatic SQL: INSERT, UPDATE, SELECT, DELETE khud banta hai.
  • Parameter binding aur ResultSet mapping automatic.
  • Relationships (embedded, one-to-many) handle karta hai.
  • Caching se DB calls kam hoti hain.
  • Transaction manager ke saath integrate hota hai.

Q137

What is the difference between JPA, Hibernate and JDBC? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • JPA (Jakarta Persistence API) is a specification: interfaces and annotations such as @Entity and @Id.
  • Hibernate is an ORM framework and the default implementation of JPA in Spring Boot.
  • JDBC is the low-level API that Hibernate uses internally to talk to the database.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • JPA rulebook है (interfaces और annotations), Hibernate उस rulebook को follow करने वाला actual framework है।
  • JDBC सबसे नीचे की plumbing है जिसे Hibernate अंदर से use करता है।

Yaad rakhoHibernate ek independent framework hai. Wo Spring ke bina bhi chalta hai.
