36. Access aur refresh tokens: expiry, rotation, logout

12 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Pichhle topic mein JWT bana aur verify hua. Par ek badi kami dikhi: server JWT ko yaad nahi rakhta, isliye use beech mein khatam nahi kar sakta. Token lamba chale to chori hone pe khatra lamba; chhota chale to user baar-baar login kare. Iska jawab: do tokens.
📖 Notes

Problem: lamba token ya baar-baar login?

1 din ka JWT chori hua to attacker 1 din tak tumhara account chalayega, aur server rok nahi sakta. 5 min ka JWT rakho to user har 5 min login kare. Dono bure. Solution: access token chhota, aur ek alag refresh token jo naya access token laata hai.

Real exampleOffice mein day pass (access token) subah milta hai, shaam ko khatam. Tumhare paas ek ID card (refresh token) hai jisse reception roz naya pass bana deta hai. Card kho jaye to reception card hi block kar deti hai.

Access vs refresh token

Refresh token ko alag se validate karo aur sirf refresh endpoint pe accept karo; normal API pe kabhi nahi. Q215

Access tokenRefresh token
Life5-15 minDin / hafte
Kahan jaataHar API call (Authorization header)Sirf /auth/refresh
FormatAksar JWT (stateless verify)Aksar opaque random string
Server peKuch store nahiDB mein hash; revoke ho sakta
Chori ka asarExpiry takRotation + reuse detection se pakda jaata

Token expire hua to flow

  1. Expired access token pe API 401 deti hai.
  2. Client /auth/refresh ko refresh token bhejta hai.
  3. Server refresh token validate karke rotate karta hai (naya access + naya refresh).
  4. Client original request ek baar retry karta hai.
  5. Refresh bhi fail: session clear, login page.
Common galti401 → refresh → 401 → refresh... infinite loop. Refresh call khud fail ho to ruk jao aur login pe bhejo. Q216

Rotation aur reuse detection

Rotation: har refresh pe naya refresh token, purana turant dead. Reuse detection: koi dead (purana) token dobara aaye to matlab do log same token chala rahe hain, yaani chori. Server poori token family revoke kar deta hai, asli user aur attacker dono bahar, user dobara login kare. Q217

Asli user:   R1 -> refresh -> R2 (R1 dead) -> refresh -> R3 (R2 dead)
Attacker:    chura liya R1 ... baad mein R1 bhejta hai
Server:      R1 already used!  -> family F1 ke saare tokens revoke -> 401
Result:      attacker ka R1 bekaar, asli user ka R3 bhi revoke -> re-login

Refresh token DB mein kaise rakho

Refresh token ek high-entropy random (opaque) string do. DB mein sirf hash, taaki DB leak hone pe bhi tokens kaam na aayein. Refresh pe: incoming token hash karo → dhoondo → expiry/revoked check → atomically rotate. Q218

ColumnPurpose
token_hashAsli token nahi, uska SHA-256 hash
user_idOwner
family_idEk login se nikle saare rotated tokens
expires_atExpiration
revoked_atKab revoke hua
replaced_byKis naye token se rotate hua
@Transactional
public TokenPair refresh(String rawToken) {
    String hash = sha256(rawToken);
    RefreshToken rt = repo.findByTokenHash(hash).orElseThrow(InvalidTokenException::new);
    if (rt.getRevokedAt() != null) {                 // reuse detected
        repo.revokeFamily(rt.getFamilyId());
        throw new InvalidTokenException();
    }
    if (rt.getExpiresAt().isBefore(Instant.now())) throw new InvalidTokenException();

    String newRaw = randomToken();                   // 32 random bytes, Base64URL
    int updated = repo.markUsed(rt.getId(), sha256(newRaw));   // conditional UPDATE (neeche)
    if (updated == 0) throw new InvalidTokenException();       // kisi aur ne pehle use kar liya
    repo.save(new RefreshToken(sha256(newRaw), rt.getUserId(), rt.getFamilyId(), Instant.now().plus(7, DAYS)));
    return new TokenPair(jwtService.generateFor(rt.getUserId()), newRaw);
}
SochoYahan BCrypt kyun nahi? Refresh token 256-bit random hai, guess nahi ho sakta, isliye fast SHA-256 kaafi. BCrypt passwords ke liye hai kyunki insaan kamzor passwords chunte hain.

Do requests, same refresh token, ek saath

SPA ke do tabs ek saath refresh karein, ya attacker aur user ek saath. Bina locking ke dono validation pass karke do valid branches bana denge, reuse detection toot jaayegi (race condition). Hal: rotation atomic, DB transaction + conditional update (compare-and-set): sirf ek jeetega. Q219

UPDATE refresh_token
   SET revoked_at = now(), replaced_by = :newHash
 WHERE id = :id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
-- request A: 1 row updated  -> naya token
-- request B: 0 rows updated -> reject (ya policy ke hisaab se reuse maano)
Dhyan doKuch systems chhota grace window (jaise 10 sec) dete hain jisme same purana token dobara aaye to family revoke nahi karte, kyunki wo asli user ka double tab ho sakta hai. Policy soch samajh ke design karo.

Expiration vs revocation

Refresh token 7 din mein expire hota hai, par logout ya chori pe turant revoke. Q220

ExpirationRevocation
KaunTime (exp)Server, jaan-boojh ke
KabFixed timeLogout, password change, reuse, compromise
Server stateNahi chahiyeChahiye (DB / denylist)

Logout with JWT

Client se JWT delete karna kaafi nahi: copy kahin aur ho sakti hai. Server pe: refresh token revoke, access token chhota rakho (5-15 min me khud mar jaayega), aur turant cut-off chahiye to access token ki jti ko denylist (Redis, TTL = token ki baaki life) mein daalo aur filter mein check karo. Q221

@PostMapping("/auth/logout")
public ResponseEntity<Void> logout(@RequestBody LogoutRequest req, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
    refreshTokenService.revoke(req.refreshToken());                 // revoked_at = now
    denylist.add(jwt.getId(), Duration.between(Instant.now(), jwt.getExpiresAt()));  // optional
    return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
}

Multiple devices

Har device ka apna session / refresh-token family. Mobile pe logout = sirf mobile ki family revoke; laptop chalta rahe. "Logout from all devices" = user ki saari families revoke; sirf user ke kehne pe ya security incident pe. Q222

DeviceFamilyMobile logout ke baad
MobileARevoked
LaptopBActive

Chori ke scenarios

Q223 Q224

Kya chori huaAsarKya karo
Access tokenExpiry tak chalegaShort TTL (5-15 min), HTTPS, zarurat pe denylist / session revoke, investigate
Refresh tokenNaye access tokens bana sakta haiFamily revoke, rotation + reuse detection, re-login, audit logs (time, device, IP)
SochoClient se token delete karna kyun bekaar? Kyunki ye asli user ke browser se delete hota hai, attacker ki copy se nahi.

Role badla par JWT purana

Admin ne Rahul ko ADMIN se USER kar diya. DB badal gaya, par Rahul ke paas pada JWT abhi bhi "role": "ADMIN" bolta hai, expiry tak. JWT ke claims issue hone ke baad nahi badalte. Q225

  • Access token short rakho: zyada se zyada 15 min ka risk
  • Sensitive operations (delete, payment) pe server DB se current role check kare
  • tokenVersion claim: user ki DB row mein version; role badla to version++, purane version wala token reject
  • Permission badalne pe us user ke refresh tokens revoke

Token browser mein kahan rakhein?

Common choice: refresh token HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite cookie mein (JS ki pahunch se bahar), access token memory mein. Koi bhi storage risk-free nahi; XSS aur CSRF dono socho. Ye CSRF wali baat agle topic mein. Q226

localStorageHttpOnly cookie
JS padh sakta?Haan: XSS = token choriNahi
Browser khud bhejta?NahiHaan: isliye CSRF risk
ZarooriStrong XSS prevention + CSPSecure + SameSite + CSRF protection
📌 Yaad rakho
  • Access token: chhota (5-15 min), har call; refresh token: lamba, sirf /auth/refresh.
  • Expire → 401 → refresh → ek baar retry → fail to login; infinite loop nahi.
  • Rotation: har refresh pe naya token; purana dobara aaye = chori → poori family revoke.
  • DB mein refresh token ka sirf hash + user_id, family_id, expires_at, revoked_at, replaced_by.
  • Rotation atomic: conditional UPDATE, sirf ek request jeete.
  • Logout: refresh revoke + short access TTL + zarurat pe jti denylist; client delete kaafi nahi.
  • Role badla to purana JWT purana role rakhta hai: short TTL, server check, token version.

✅ Review questions (12): ab khud check karo

Q215

What are access tokens and refresh tokens? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • An access token is a short-lived credential sent with each API call.
  • A refresh token is long-lived and is used only at the refresh endpoint to get a new access token.
  • Best practice: short expiry, rotation, reuse detection, server-side storage and revocation.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Access token एक day pass जैसा है: जल्दी expire होता है और हर API call में भेजते हैं।
  • Refresh token एक card जैसा है जिससे नया pass बनता है।
  • ये लंबा चलता है और सिर्फ़ refresh endpoint पर use होता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
Access tokenRefresh token
Life5-15 minDin / hafte
Kahan jaataHar API callSirf /auth/refresh
FormatAksar JWTAksar opaque random string
Server peStateless verifyDB mein hash, revocable
  • Access-token lifetime short (5 se 15 min)
  • Refresh-token rotation + reuse detection
  • Refresh tokens secure store karo (server pe hash)
  • Logout ya compromise par revoke
  • Refresh token ko kabhi normal API access token ki tarah accept mat karo
Important 77 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q213)★ Important listAgla important (Q227) → ★
Q216

JWT expire ho gaya toh kya karoge?

Main Definition

  • The API rejects it with 401.
  • The client calls the refresh endpoint with a valid refresh token, the server validates and rotates it, and the client retries the original request once.
  • If refresh fails, the user must log in again.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Token expire होने पर API 401 देती है।
  • Client refresh token से नया access token लेता है और original request एक बार retry करता है।
  • Refresh भी fail हो तो login page।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  1. Expired access token par API 401 deti hai.
  2. Refresh token valid ho to client refresh try karta hai.
  3. Server refresh token validate + rotate karta hai.
  4. Client naye access token se original request ek baar retry karta hai.
  5. Refresh fail: session clear, login page.
Dhyan do401 par infinite retry loop mat banao.
Q217

What is refresh-token rotation, and how does reuse detection work?

Main Definition

  • Rotation means every refresh returns a new refresh token and invalidates the old one.
  • Reuse detection: if an old token is presented again, it signals theft, so the server revokes the whole token family.
  • Rotation must be atomic.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • हर refresh पर नया token मिलता है और पुराना invalid हो जाता है।
  • अगर पुराना token फिर आए तो मतलब चोरी हुई है, पूरी family revoke कर दो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Token records ya hashes server-side store karo taaki revocation aur reuse detection kaam kare
  • Atomically rotate karo taaki do concurrent requests same token use na kar paayein
  • Unpredictable tokens jo sahi user / session se bound hon
  • Generic errors return karo, details leak mat karo
Dhyan doJWT refresh token apne aap revocable nahi hota. Revocation ke liye server-side mechanism chahiye.
Q218

Refresh token ko database mein kaise store karoge?

Main Definition

  • Store only a hash of a high-entropy opaque refresh token, along with user_id, family_id, expires_at, revoked_at and replaced_by.
  • On refresh, hash the incoming token, look it up, check expiry and revocation, and rotate atomically.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Database में असली refresh token नहीं, उसका hash save करो (password की तरह)।
  • साथ में user_id, family, expiry और revoke time भी रखो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
ColumnPurpose
token_hashToken ko securely pehchanna (SHA-256 kaafi, token random hai)
user_idToken owner
family_idRotated tokens ka group
expires_atExpiration
revoked_atRevocation timestamp
replaced_byRotation tracking
SochoYahan BCrypt ki zarurat nahi: refresh token 256-bit random hai, guess nahi ho sakta, isliye fast SHA-256 hash theek hai. Password ke liye BCrypt isliye kyunki passwords insaan chunte hain (kamzor).
Q219

What happens if two requests use the same refresh token simultaneously?

Main Definition

  • Without control, both can pass validation and create two valid branches, which breaks reuse detection (a race condition).
  • Make rotation atomic using a database transaction with a conditional update (compare-and-set), so only one request can consume the token.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • दो requests एक साथ same refresh token लेकर आएँ तो दोनों को नया token मिल सकता है।
  • इसलिए database में atomic update (transaction) से ensure करो कि सिर्फ़ एक ही success हो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • DB transaction + conditional update
  • Unique token identifier / token state
  • Duplicate refresh requests safely handle karo (jaise SPA ke do tabs)
  • Reuse-detection policy dhyan se design karo (chhota grace window?)
-- sirf ek request jeetegi: updated rows = 1, doosri ko 0
UPDATE refresh_token
   SET revoked_at = now(), replaced_by = :newId
 WHERE token_hash = :hash AND revoked_at IS NULL;
Q220

What is the difference between token revocation and token expiration?

Main Definition

  • Expiration is automatic invalidation at the token's exp time.
  • Revocation is explicitly invalidating a token or session before expiry, for example on logout, password change or detected reuse.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Expiration automatically time पूरा होने पर होता है।
  • Revocation हम खुद expiry से पहले करते हैं, जैसे logout या token चोरी होने पर।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
ExpirationRevocation
Kaun kartaTime (exp claim)Server, jaan-boojh kar
KabFixed time parLogout, password change, reuse, compromise
Server state chahiye?NahiHaan (DB / denylist)
Real exampleRefresh token 7 din mein expire hota hai, par logout, password compromise ya suspicious reuse par turant revoke ho sakta hai.
Q221

User logout karta hai, toh JWT kaise invalidate karoge?

Main Definition

  • A JWT is self-contained, so deleting it on the client is not enough.
  • On logout, revoke the refresh token or server session, keep access tokens short-lived, and add an access-token denylist (jti) if immediate invalidation is needed.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • JWT को browser से delete करना काफ़ी नहीं, क्योंकि उसकी copy कहीं और हो सकती है।
  • Logout पर server पर refresh token revoke करो और access token short रखो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
@PostMapping("/auth/logout")
public ResponseEntity<Void> logout(@RequestBody LogoutRequest req) {
    refreshTokenService.revoke(req.refreshToken());    // DB: revoked_at = now
    // optional: denylist.add(accessJti, untilExp)      // Redis, TTL = token ki baaki life
    return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
}
Yaad rakhoStateless auth se validation aasan hota hai, par immediate revocation ke liye extra design chahiye. Service ko token validate karke sahi record revoke karna chahiye.
Q222

Ek user multiple devices par login hai. Ek device se logout karne par kya hoga?

Main Definition

  • Keep a separate session or refresh-token family per device.
  • Logout revokes only that device's session.
  • Logout from all devices (global revocation) is used only on user request or a security incident.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • हर device का अपना अलग session होता है।
  • Mobile से logout करो तो सिर्फ़ mobile का session बंद होगा, laptop चलता रहेगा, जब तक "logout from all devices" न चुनो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Mobile: Session A (family A), Laptop: Session B (family B)
  • Mobile par logout: sirf Session A revoke
  • Session B active, jab tak global logout ya security incident na ho
  • Global logout = user ki saari families revoke (+ token version badhao)
Q223

Access token chori ho gaya, toh kya karoge?

Main Definition

  • A stolen access token works until expiry, so keep it short-lived (5 to 15 minutes), use HTTPS, and apply a denylist / revocation or session invalidation if you need an immediate cut-off.
  • Deleting it on the client does nothing about a copied token.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • चोरी हुआ access token expire होने तक चलता है।
  • इसलिए उसकी expiry short (5 से 15 minute) रखो और ज़रूरत हो तो server पर block (denylist) करो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Expiry short: 5-15 min
  • HTTPS everywhere
  • Insecure token storage avoid karo
  • Compromise ka shak ho to session / token family revoke
  • Suspicious API activity investigate karo
SochoClient se JWT delete kyun kaafi nahi? Kyunki asli user ke browser se delete karne se attacker ke paas wali copy invalid nahi hoti.
Q224

Refresh token chori ho gaya, ab kya karoge?

Main Definition

  • Revoke the token family, use refresh-token rotation with reuse detection, force re-authentication, and investigate the audit logs.
  • Refresh tokens are stored server-side as hashes, so revocation takes effect immediately.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Refresh token चोरी हो गया तो उसकी पूरी token family revoke करो, user से दोबारा login करवाओ और logs check करो कि क्या हुआ।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Server-side store mein token invalid mark karo
  • Evidence ho to user ke baaki active sessions bhi revoke
  • Audit logs: timestamps, devices, ajeeb requests
  • Re-login + zarurat ho to extra verification
  1. Attacker R1 chura leta hai.
  2. R1 se naya access token maanga jaata hai.
  3. Server R1 ko R2 se rotate karke R1 invalid kar deta hai.
  4. R1 dobara aata hai: reuse detected.
  5. Poori family revoke, investigate, re-login zaroori.
Q225

User ka role ADMIN se USER ho gaya, lekin purane JWT mein ADMIN role hai. Kya karoge?

Main Definition

  • The JWT keeps the old role claim until it expires.
  • Use short-lived tokens, check current permissions on the server for sensitive operations, or keep a token / session version and revoke sessions when permissions change.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Database में role change करने से पुराने token का role नहीं बदलता।
  • इसलिए token short रखो, sensitive काम में server पर current role check करो या पुराने sessions revoke करो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Short-lived access tokens
  • Sensitive operations ke liye server-side permission lookup
  • Session ya token version check (tokenVersion claim vs DB)
  • Permissions badalne par active sessions / refresh tokens revoke
Dhyan doKabhi mat maano ki DB mein role badalne se already-issued JWT ke claims badal gaye.
Q226

JWT ko localStorage mein store karna safe hai?

Main Definition

  • localStorage is readable by JavaScript, so any XSS can steal the token.
  • A common choice is HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite cookies, combined with CSRF protection and a strict Content Security Policy.
  • The right choice depends on the threat model.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • localStorage को JavaScript पढ़ सकता है, इसलिए XSS attack में token चोरी हो सकता है।
  • HttpOnly cookie better है, पर तब CSRF protection भी लगाना पड़ेगा।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
localStorageHttpOnly cookie
JS padh sakta?Haan (XSS = chori)Nahi
Browser khud bhejta?Nahi (header mein daalna padta)Haan (isliye CSRF risk)
Zaroori bachavStrong XSS prevention, CSPSameSite + CSRF token
Yaad rakhoKoi bhi browser storage risk-free nahi hai. Design mein XSS aur CSRF dono sochne padte hain. Refresh token ko unnecessary client-side code se door rakho.
➡️ Agle topic mein: system ban gaya, ab hackers ise kaise todenge? CSRF, CORS, headers, brute-force aur REST/payment API ka poora security checklist.Agla topic: Web attacks se bachav: CSRF, CORS, brute-force →

37. Web attacks se bachav: CSRF, CORS, brute-force

8 questions
🔗 Pichhle topic se jodo: Pichhle topic ke aakhir mein dekha ki token cookie mein rakho to browser use khud bhejta hai, aur localStorage mein rakho to XSS chura sakta hai. Ab un attacks ko seedha samjhte hain jo browser ke isi 'khud bhejne' wale behaviour ka fayda uthate hain, aur phir poori API ko secure karne ki checklist.
📖 Notes

CSRF: browser se tumhare naam pe request

Tum bank.com pe login ho (session cookie browser mein). Ek doosre tab mein evil.com kholte ho. Usme chhupa form bank.com/transfer ko POST karta hai. Browser bank.com ki cookie apne aap laga deta hai, aur bank ko lagta hai request tumne bheji. Yahi Cross-Site Request Forgery hai. Q227

<!-- evil.com -->
<form action="https://bank.com/transfer" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="to" value="attacker">
  <input type="hidden" name="amount" value="50000">
</form>
<script>document.forms[0].submit()</script>
Yaad rakhoAttacker response padh nahi sakta, sirf request bhijwa sakta hai. Isliye target hai state badalne wali requests: transfer, password change, delete.

CSRF ka bachav

  • CSRF token (synchronizer token pattern): server har form/session ke saath ek random token deta hai; state-changing request mein wo token bhi aana chahiye. evil.com ko ye token pata nahi.
  • SameSite cookie (Lax / Strict): browser cross-site requests mein cookie bhejta hi nahi.
  • Spring mein CSRF default ON hai: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE bina token = 403.
// SPA (React/Angular) + cookie session: token cookie mein, JS header mein wapas bhejta hai
http.csrf(csrf -> csrf
    .csrfTokenRepository(CookieCsrfTokenRepository.withHttpOnlyFalse()));
// browser: XSRF-TOKEN cookie  ->  request header: X-XSRF-TOKEN

CSRF kab disable karna theek hai

Agar auth Bearer token Authorization header mein jaata hai (JS khud lagata hai) aur koi cookie-based auth nahi, to browser kuch apne aap nahi bhejta, CSRF possible nahi. Tab disable theek. Q228

http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable());                                  // pure Bearer-token API
http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.ignoringRequestMatchers("/api/webhooks/**")); // sirf kuch paths
Common galti"REST API hai to CSRF band" galat soch hai. Sawaal ye hai: kya browser credential (cookie) apne aap bhejta hai? Refresh token HttpOnly cookie mein hai to /auth/refresh pe CSRF bachav chahiye.

CORS: attack nahi, browser ka rule

Browser ka same-origin policy: app.com ka JavaScript api.com ko call kare to browser response JS ko nahi dega, jab tak api.com header se allow na kare. CORS wahi permission system hai (Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Non-simple request (PUT, JSON, Authorization header) se pehle browser OPTIONS preflight bhejta hai.

CSRF ek attack hai; CORS ek browser policy. CORS authentication nahi hai: Postman/curl pe CORS lagta hi nahi. Q229

CORSCSRF
KyaBrowser policyAttack
Kaun lagataBrowserAttacker
Config / bachavAllowed origins, methods, headersCSRF token, SameSite
Galat setup* + credentialsCookie app mein CSRF band
@Bean
CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
    CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();
    config.setAllowedOrigins(List.of("https://myapp.example.com"));
    config.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE"));
    config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("Authorization", "Content-Type"));
    UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
    source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", config);
    return source;
}
// SecurityFilterChain: http.cors(Customizer.withDefaults());  -> preflight security se pehle handle
Common galtihttp.cors() bhool gaye to preflight OPTIONS bina token aata hai aur security 401 de deti hai: browser mein 'CORS error' dikhta hai jabki asal mein security ne roka. Aur credentials ke saath * origin kabhi nahi.

Security headers aur HTTPS

HTTPS/TLS zaroori hai: bina iske password, cookie aur JWT network pe plain text mein jaate hain, cafe Wi-Fi pe koi bhi padh le. Q230

Header (default)Kya rokta hai
Cache-Control: no-cache, no-storeLogout ke baad back button se private page
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniffMIME sniffing
X-Frame-Options: DENYClickjacking (page ko iframe mein chhupana)
Strict-Transport-Security (HTTPS pe)HTTP downgrade
Content-Security-Policy (khud add karo)XSS: sirf allowed sources se script
http.headers(h -> h
    .contentSecurityPolicy(csp -> csp.policyDirectives("default-src 'self'"))
    .frameOptions(f -> f.deny()));

Brute-force: baar-baar password guess

Attacker ek account pe hazaron passwords try karta hai (ya ek common password hazaron accounts pe: credential stuffing). Q231

  • Rate limit per IP aur per account
  • Temporary lockout ya progressive delay (1s, 2s, 4s...)
  • MFA / OTP, zarurat pe CAPTCHA
  • Generic error: "Invalid username or password" (kaun galat, mat batao)
  • Monitoring + alerts
if (failedAttempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    lockAccountTemporarily(username, Duration.ofMinutes(15));   // permanent nahi
}
Common galtiPermanent lockout: attacker jaan-boojh ke galat password daal ke asli users ko hamesha ke liye bahar kar dega (denial of service).

Kai servers pe brute-force

App 3 instances pe hai aur counter har instance ki memory mein, to attacker ko 3 guna attempts mil gaye. Counter shared store (Redis) mein rakho, aur gateway/edge pe bhi limit lagao (Spring Cloud Gateway RequestRateLimiter, WAF). Distributed attack (kai IPs) ke liye per-account limit bhi zaroori. Q232

REST API security checklist

Ek cheez se API secure nahi hoti; layers lagti hain. Ye poore Part 7 ka saar hai. Q233

LayerKya karoTopic
AuthenticationJWT / OAuth2 resource server, BCrypt passwords2, 4
AuthorizationRoles/authorities + ownership (BOLA)3
TokensShort access, rotated refresh, revocation5
TransportHTTPS everywhere, HSTS6
BrowserStrict CORS, CSRF jahan cookie6
AbuseRate limit, lockout, MFA6
InputValidation, request size limitsPart 3
Errors / logsClean 401/403, logs mein password/token nahi1
SecretsCode se bahar (env / vault), least privilege DB user-
http.authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
    .requestMatchers("/public/**").permitAll()
    .requestMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
    .anyRequest().authenticated());   // deny by default

Payment / admin API: extra layers

Payment API ke sabse bade risks: duplicate payment, galat amount, aur doosre ka data. Q234

  • Idempotency key: client har payment pe unique key bheje; server same key dobara aaye to pehla result lautaye, dobara charge nahi
  • Amount aur ownership server pe nikaalo/check karo; client ka bheja price kabhi trust nahi
  • Step-up auth: payment / admin action pe OTP ya dobara password
  • Replay / tampering se bachav: nonce + timestamp, signed requests
  • Least privilege, rate limit, signing keys secure
  • Audit logs (kisne, kab, kya) bina credentials ke
POST /api/payments
Idempotency-Key: 7f3c9a2e-1b4d-4c8e-9f0a-2d6b5e8c1a33
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...
{ "orderId": 101 }        // amount server order se nikaalega

// pehli baar: 201 Created, payment done
// same key se retry (network glitch): 200, wahi purana result, dobara charge nahi
SochoHar security jawab mein teen cheezein socho: risk kya hai, server pe abhi kya action loge, aur aage issue kaise rokoge.
📌 Yaad rakho
  • CSRF = browser cookie apne aap bhejta hai; bachav CSRF token + SameSite; Spring mein default on.
  • CSRF disable sirf pure Bearer-header API pe; cookie hai to on.
  • CORS = browser policy, attack nahi, auth nahi; http.cors() + exact origins, * + credentials kabhi nahi.
  • Default headers: nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, no-cache, HSTS; CSP khud add; HTTPS zaroori.
  • Brute-force: IP + account rate limit (Redis), temporary lockout, MFA, generic errors; permanent lock nahi.
  • Payment API: idempotency key, server-side amount/ownership, step-up auth, audit logs.

✅ Review questions (8): ab khud check karo

Q227

What is CSRF? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) is an attack where a malicious site makes the victim's browser send a state-changing request to a site where they are already logged in, because the browser attaches cookies automatically.
  • Spring defends with a CSRF token (synchronizer token pattern) and SameSite cookies.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • CSRF में एक fake website आपके browser से, आपको पता चले बिना, आपके bank को request भेज देती है।
  • Browser cookie automatically लगा देता है, तो bank को लगता है request आपने ही भेजी है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
<!-- evil.com par chhupa form -->
<form action="https://bank.com/transfer" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="to" value="attacker">
  <input type="hidden" name="amount" value="50000">
</form>
<script>document.forms[0].submit()</script>
<!-- browser bank.com ki session cookie khud laga deta hai -->
SochoREST API mein CSRF protection chahiye? Depends. Bearer token Authorization header mein explicitly jaata hai aur browser koi credential apne aap nahi bhejta, to aksar CSRF band rakhte hain. Cookie-based auth mein zaroori hai.
Important 78 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q215)★ Important listAgla important (Q229) → ★
Q228

How do you disable CSRF?

Main Definition

  • With http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable()), but only for stateless APIs that use a Bearer token in the Authorization header and no cookie-based authentication.
  • If the app uses session cookies, CSRF protection must stay enabled.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • CSRF disable करना एक line का code है, पर तभी करो जब login cookie से नहीं, Authorization header वाले token से हो।
  • Cookie वाले app में CSRF on रखो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable());

// Sirf kuch paths ke liye ignore
http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.ignoringRequestMatchers("/api/webhooks/**"));
Dhyan doSirf isliye CSRF band mat karo ki 'ye REST API hai'. Pehle check karo ki browser authentication apne aap bhejta hai ya nahi, khaaskar cookies.
Q229

What is CORS, and how is it different from CSRF? ★ Important

Main Definition

  • CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) is a browser-enforced policy, controlled by headers like Access-Control-Allow-Origin, that decides which origins can call your API from JavaScript.
  • CSRF is an attack that abuses an authenticated session, so the two are different.
  • CORS does not replace authentication.
  • In Spring, expose a CorsConfigurationSource and enable http.cors().

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • CORS browser का rule है कि कौन-सी दूसरी website आपकी API call कर सकती है।
  • CSRF एक attack है।
  • दोनों अलग चीज़ें हैं, और CORS login का replacement नहीं है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
CORSCSRF
Kya haiBrowser policy (relaxation of same-origin)Attack
Kaun lagataBrowser, server ke headers padh karAttacker
Bachav / configAllowed origins, methods, headersCSRF token, SameSite cookie
Postman / curl pe asar?Nahi (sirf browser)Nahi (browser cookie ka attack)
@Bean
CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
    CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();
    config.setAllowedOrigins(List.of("https://myapp.example.com"));
    config.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE"));
    config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("Authorization", "Content-Type"));
    UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
    source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", config);
    return source;
}
// SecurityFilterChain mein: http.cors(Customizer.withDefaults());
Dhyan doCredentials ke saath * (unrestricted origins) production mein kabhi nahi. CORS authentication ya authorization ka replacement nahi hai.
Important 79 / 91
★ ← Pichhla important (Q227)★ Important listAgla important (Q235) → ★
Q230

Which security headers does Spring Security add, and why use HTTPS?

Main Definition

  • By default Spring adds headers like Cache-Control (no caching of secure pages), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY (stops clickjacking) and Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) on HTTPS.
  • You can add a Content-Security-Policy to reduce XSS.
  • HTTPS/TLS is mandatory, because without it tokens, cookies and passwords travel in plain text.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Security headers browser को बताते हैं: page को iframe में मत दिखाओ, cache मत करो, सिर्फ़ HTTPS use करो।
  • HTTPS के बिना password और token network पर कोई भी पढ़ सकता है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
HeaderKya rokta hai
Cache-Control: no-cache, no-storeLogout ke baad back button se private page
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniffBrowser ka content type guess karna (MIME sniffing)
X-Frame-Options: DENYClickjacking (page ko iframe mein chhupana)
Strict-Transport-SecurityHTTP downgrade; browser hamesha HTTPS use kare
Content-Security-PolicyXSS: sirf allowed jagah se scripts
http.headers(h -> h
    .contentSecurityPolicy(csp -> csp.policyDirectives("default-src 'self'"))
    .frameOptions(f -> f.deny())

Q231

How do you prevent brute-force attacks?

Main Definition

  • A brute-force attack tries many passwords against an account.
  • Prevent it with rate limiting (per IP and per account), temporary lockout or progressive delay, MFA / CAPTCHA, generic error messages, and monitoring and alerting.
  • Avoid permanent lockout because it enables denial of service.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Brute-force में attacker बार-बार password guess करता है।
  • Solution: कुछ wrong attempts के बाद rate limit, थोड़ी देर का account lock, OTP/CAPTCHA और alerts।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Account aur IP dono se rate limit
  • Temporary lockout ya progressive delay
  • Zarurat par CAPTCHA
  • MFA
  • Suspicious login patterns par alerts
  • Error: 'Invalid username or password' (kaun galat, mat batao)
if (failedAttempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
    lockAccountTemporarily(username, Duration.ofMinutes(15));
}
Dhyan doYe sirf illustration hai. Counters atomically update karo, expiry aur recovery policy rakho, aur permanent lockout avoid karo.
Q232

API par brute-force attack ho raha hai. Kaise protect karoge?

Main Definition

  • Apply rate limiting per IP and per account, with a shared store like Redis so limits work across instances, plus progressive delays or temporary lockout, MFA / CAPTCHA, generic error messages and alerting.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Multiple servers हों तो rate limit counter Redis जैसी shared जगह पर रखो।
  • Error message generic रखो और permanent lock मत करो।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Account + IP se rate limit, distributed attack (kai IPs) ke safeguards ke saath
  • Kai instances mein limit ke liye Redis jaisa shared store
  • Generic login errors
  • Suspicious patterns par alerts
  • Permanent lockout nahi (attacker asli users ko bahar kar dega)
  • Gateway / edge (Spring Cloud Gateway RequestRateLimiter, WAF) par bhi limit
Q233

How do you secure REST APIs?

Main Definition

  • With authentication and authorization, JWT or OAuth 2.0, HTTPS/TLS, input validation, a strict CORS policy, rate limiting and BCrypt password storage.
  • Also handle exceptions properly (401/403), apply least privilege, and never log secrets or tokens.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • API secure करने के लिए कई layers एक साथ लगाते हैं: login + permission, HTTPS, input validation, rate limit, और logs में कोई secret नहीं।
  • एक चीज़ से API secure नहीं होती।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • Inputs aur request sizes validate karo
  • Secrets source code se bahar (env / vault)
  • Login aur sensitive endpoints par rate limit
  • Token ka issuer, audience, expiry aur signature validate
  • Services aur DB accounts ke liye least privilege
  • Passwords, access tokens ya personal data log mat karo
  • Har resource par ownership check (BOLA)
http.authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
    .requestMatchers("/public/**").permitAll()
    .requestMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ADMIN")
    .anyRequest().authenticated()
);
Q234

How would you secure a payment or admin API?

Main Definition

  • Use least-privilege authorization, server-side validation of resource ownership and amounts, HTTPS, rate limiting, audit logging, step-up authentication, idempotency keys to prevent duplicate payments, and protection against replay and tampering.

Hindi mein samjho (आसान भाषा)

  • Payment API में सबसे बड़े risks हैं: duplicate payment, wrong amount और दूसरे user का data।
  • इसलिए idempotency key, server पर amount और ownership check, और re-verification ज़रूरी है।
Poora answer, code aur detail (click karke kholo)
  • High-risk operations par re-authentication / step-up (OTP)
  • Duplicate payment rokne ke liye idempotency keys
  • Amount aur ownership server pe validate (client ka bheja price kabhi trust nahi)
  • Replay aur request tampering se bachav (nonce/timestamp, signed requests)
  • Secrets aur signing keys secure manage karo
  • Audit logs, bina credentials aur sensitive data ke
