Auto-closes ResultSet, Statement, Connection in reverse order.
Resources अपने आप reverse order में close होते हैं।
JDBC transaction → Q127
setAutoCommit(false), then commit() or rollback().
सब steps हों या कोई नहीं: commit या rollback।
JdbcTemplate → Q130
Template pattern: Spring owns the fixed flow, you give SQL + RowMapper.
Fixed steps Spring के, SQL और RowMapper तुम्हारे।
HikariCP → Q131
Default pool; reuses connections, close() returns to pool.
Connections reuse होते हैं, close() pool में वापस भेजता है।
queryForObject → Q133
Exactly one row; 0 rows = EmptyResultDataAccessException.
एक ही row चाहिए, 0 पर exception।
DataAccessException → Q135
Unchecked, vendor-neutral translation of SQLException.
SQLException को unchecked common exception में बदलता है।
JPA vs Hibernate → Q137
JPA is the spec, Hibernate the implementation, JDBC the plumbing.
JPA rulebook, Hibernate implementation।
ddl-auto → Q138
none / validate / update / create / create-drop; never create in prod.
Production में validate या none रखो।
Enum mapping → Q140
Always EnumType.STRING, never ORDINAL.
Enum हमेशा STRING में store करो।
Persistence Context → Q146
L1 cache per transaction; same id = no second SELECT.
एक transaction का notebook, दोबारा find पर SQL नहीं।
merge() → Q147
Returns a managed copy of a detached entity.
merge() नई managed copy देता है।
Lifecycle → Q148
Transient, Managed, Detached, Removed.
चार states, सिर्फ़ Managed track होती है।
Dirty checking → Q149
Managed entity changes auto-UPDATE at flush/commit.
Managed entity बदलो, commit पर UPDATE खुद।
Batch insert → Q150
flush() + clear() every N; IDENTITY disables batching.
हर 100 पर flush और clear।
Owning side → Q151
Holds the FK with @JoinColumn; inverse uses mappedBy.
FK वाली side owning, दूसरी पर mappedBy।
FK placement → Q152
In ManyToOne/OneToMany the 'many' table holds the FK.
FK हमेशा 'many' वाली table में।
ManyToMany → Q154
Needs a join table with two FKs.
बीच में join table बनती है।
Cascade → Q155
REMOVE/ALL only on parent-child composition.
Cascade REMOVE सिर्फ़ parent-child पर।
Fetch defaults → Q156
ToOne = EAGER, ToMany = LAZY; prefer LAZY everywhere.
ToOne EAGER, ToMany LAZY, best: सब LAZY।
N+1 → Q157
1 query + N lazy loads; fix with JOIN FETCH / @EntityGraph.
Loop में lazy access = 1+N queries।
save() → Q162
persist() if new, else merge(); saveAll() is a loop.
नया हो तो persist, वरना merge।
Page vs Slice → Q165
Page = data + COUNT (2 queries); Slice = 1 query.
Total चाहिए तो Page, infinite scroll में Slice।
rollbackFor → Q167
Default rollback only on unchecked; rollbackFor = Exception.class for checked.
Checked exception पर rollback के लिए rollbackFor।

Part 6: Production-ready Spring Boot

Test pyramid → Q169
Many unit, some slice (@WebMvcTest/@DataJpaTest), few @SpringBootTest
बहुत unit tests, कुछ slice tests, थोड़े full integration tests।
Mockito → Q172
@Mock fake, @InjectMocks real; when/thenReturn stubs, verify checks, ArgumentCaptor captures
Mock नकली dependency है; when से behaviour, verify से check।
@WebMvcTest → Q173
Web slice + MockMvc; service via @MockitoBean (Boot 3.4+, was @MockBean)
सिर्फ़ controller layer, service को @MockitoBean से fake करो।
Testcontainers → Q174
Real DB in Docker; @ServiceConnection sets datasource (Boot 3.1+)
Docker में असली DB, @ServiceConnection से URL अपने आप set।
Actuator exposure → Q177
Expose only health,info,prometheus; separate port; secure the rest
सिर्फ़ ज़रूरी endpoints खोलो, env और heapdump public नहीं।
Logging → Q178
SLF4J + Logback, {} placeholders, exception last; logback-spring.xml; Boot 3.4 JSON logs
{} placeholder use करो, exception last argument में दो।
MDC → Q180
Filter puts requestId in MDC, remove in finally
Filter में requestId डालो, finally में हटाओ।
Metrics → Q181
Micrometer Counter/Timer/Gauge → /actuator/prometheus → Prometheus → Grafana
Micrometer गिनता है, Prometheus खींचता है, Grafana दिखाता है।
@Cacheable family → Q183
Cacheable = skip on hit; CachePut = always run + update; CacheEvict = remove
Cacheable hit पर method skip, CachePut update, CacheEvict delete।
Cache provider → Q184
Default map has no TTL; Caffeine local; Redis distributed for many instances
Multiple instances हों तो Redis, single में Caffeine।
Cache self-invocation → Q186
this.method() bypasses the proxy, so no caching; use another bean
Class के अंदर से call करने पर cache नहीं लगता।

Part 7: Spring Security

Authentication vs Authorization → Q188
Who are you (fail = 401) vs what can you do (fail = 403).
पहचान पहले, permission बाद में।
Request flow → Q191
Request → DelegatingFilterProxy → FilterChainProxy → SecurityFilterChain filters → DispatcherServlet → Controller.
हर request पहले filters से गुज़रती है।
SecurityFilterChain → Q193
Bean with HttpSecurity rules: permitAll, authenticated, hasRole. Replaced WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter.
Rules की list, एक @Bean में।
401 vs 403 handlers → Q195
AuthenticationEntryPoint → 401. AccessDeniedHandler → 403.
दो अलग handlers।
SecurityContextHolder → Q196
ThreadLocal by default; propagate the context to async threads.
Current user की pocket।
Login internals → Q199
AuthenticationManager (ProviderManager) → DaoAuthenticationProvider → UserDetailsService + PasswordEncoder → SecurityContextHolder.
Manager → Provider → user लाओ + password मिलाओ।
Passwords → Q201
BCrypt / Argon2: slow + salted + adaptive. Compare with matches(), never equals(). Never MD5 / SHA-256.
Password कभी plain नहीं, सिर्फ़ BCrypt hash।
Session fixation → Q203
Spring changes the session ID on login (changeSessionId).
Login पर नया session ID।
hasRole vs hasAuthority → Q206
hasRole('ADMIN') checks ROLE_ADMIN. hasAuthority checks the exact string.
ROLE_ prefix अपने-आप लगता है।
Method security → Q207
@EnableMethodSecurity + @PreAuthorize (before), @PostAuthorize (after, read-only).
Method पर lock।
BOLA / IDOR → Q208
Role check is not enough: verify the resource belongs to the current user.
ये record इसी user का है?
Stateless → Q210
SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS: no HttpSession, token on every request.
Server कुछ याद नहीं रखता।
JWT → Q212
Header.Payload.Signature. Signed, not encrypted. Validate signature, alg, exp, iss, aud. Decode is not validate.
Stamp check करो, सिर्फ़ पढ़ो मत।
OAuth 2.0 vs JWT → Q214
OAuth 2.0 = framework to get and use tokens. JWT = token format. Your API = Resource Server.
Rules बनाम format।
Access vs Refresh → Q215
Access: short (5-15 min), every call. Refresh: long, only at /refresh, stored hashed, rotated.
छोटा pass और लंबा card।
Rotation + reuse detection → Q217
New refresh token every time, old one dead. Old one reused → revoke whole family. Rotate atomically.
पुराना token दोबारा आए तो चोरी।
Logout with JWT → Q221
Revoke refresh token / session, short access TTL, denylist by jti if instant cut-off is needed.
Client से delete करना काफ़ी नहीं।
Role changed, old JWT → Q225
Old claim stays until expiry: short TTL, server-side check, token version, revoke sessions.
पुराना token पुराना role रखता है।
Token storage → Q226
localStorage → XSS risk. Prefer HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite cookie + CSRF protection.
HttpOnly cookie बेहतर।
CSRF → Q227
Attack via auto-sent cookies. Keep ON for cookie/session auth; disable only for Bearer-header stateless APIs.
Cookie है तो CSRF on।
CORS → Q229
Browser origin policy (Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Not an attack, not authentication. Never * with credentials.
कौन-सी site API call कर सकती है।
Brute-force → Q231
Rate limit per IP + account (Redis), temporary lockout, MFA/CAPTCHA, generic errors, alerts.
बार-बार कोशिश रोको।

Part 8: Microservices

Microservice → Q235
Small independently deployable service owning one business capability and its own DB.
एक business काम, अपना database, अलग deploy होने वाली छोटी service।
Monolith vs micro → Q236
One deployable + shared DB vs many independent services; flexibility vs complexity.
Monolith सब एक jar में; microservices अलग-अलग, पर network और ops मुश्किल।
Decompose → Q238
Split by business capability / bounded context; migrate with strangler fig.
Layer से नहीं, business काम से तोड़ो; धीरे-धीरे strangler fig से।
HTTP clients → Q240
RestClient = sync, WebClient = reactive, OpenFeign = declarative interface.
RestClient सीधा sync, WebClient reactive, Feign में बस interface लिखो।
Sync vs async → Q241
Need answer now → REST; just notify → events via Kafka/RabbitMQ.
जवाब अभी चाहिए तो REST, बस बताना है तो event।
Eureka → Q244
Registry: services register + heartbeat; callers resolve by name; @LoadBalanced / lb://.
Phone book: नाम दो, live instance का address मिलेगा।
API Gateway → Q246
Single entry point: routing, JWT check, rate limit, CORS (Spring Cloud Gateway).
Main gate: हर request यहीं से अंदर, auth और routing एक जगह।
Config → Q248
Config Server (Git) or K8s ConfigMap/Secret; @RefreshScope + /actuator/refresh.
Config jar से बाहर एक जगह; Config Server या ConfigMap।
Circuit breaker → Q249
CLOSED → OPEN (fail fast + fallback) → HALF_OPEN trial; Resilience4j.
MCB जैसा: बार-बार fail तो calls रोक दो, बाद में धीरे से check।
Saga → Q253
Chain of local transactions with compensating actions; choreography or orchestration.
हर service का local transaction; fail हुआ तो refund जैसे compensation।
Outbox + idempotency → Q255
Save event with data in same TX; consumers handle duplicates safely.
Event और data एक transaction में; duplicate message पर दो बार काम नहीं।
Tracing → Q256
traceId per request, spanId per hop; Micrometer Tracing + Zipkin.
Courier tracking ID जैसा: request किस service में कितनी देर रुकी।
Security → Q258
OAuth2/JWT: gateway validates, every service is a resource server too.
Gateway token check करे और हर service भी खुद verify करे।

Practice: khud se poocho

Pehle khud bolo, phir answer kholo
1Constructor injection par circular dependency error aaya

BeanCurrentlyInCreationException. Best fix: common logic teesri service mein. Temporary: ek param par @Lazy.

2Do beans same interface implement karte hain, app start nahi ho raha

NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException. Ek par @Primary lagao ya injection point par @Qualifier("beanName") do.

3Constructor mein injected field null kyun hai?

Field injection constructor ke baad hota hai. Kaam @PostConstruct mein karo ya constructor injection use karo.

4Controller 404 de raha hai par code sahi hai

Controller main class ke package ke bahar ho sakta hai, component scan use nahi dekhta.

5Prototype bean ka @PreDestroy kyun nahi chala?

Container prototype ko banata hai par destroy manage nahi karta. Cleanup caller ko karna hoga.

6Prod mein real SMS, dev mein dummy chahiye

Do implementations, ek par @Profile("prod"), dusre par @Profile({"dev","default"}). Run par --spring.profiles.active=prod.

7mvn package aur mvn install mein kya farak?

Dono test tak chalate hain. package JAR target/ mein banata hai, install use local ~/.m2 mein bhi copy karta hai.

8Port 8080 busy hai

server.port=9090 properties mein, ya --server.port=9090 command line par.

9WAR mein servlet-api bundle ho gaya aur Tomcat par error

Dependency ko <scope>provided</scope> do, Tomcat runtime par khud deta hai.

10Update ke liye save() kyun nahi likha?

Entity transaction ke andar Managed hai. Commit par dirty checking changes pakadti hai aur UPDATE chala deti hai.

11100 students nikale aur 101 queries chalin

N+1 problem: lazy relation loop mein access hui. Fix: @EntityGraph, JOIN FETCH ya batch fetching.

12Detached entity ka naam badla, DB mein kyun nahi gaya?

Detached entity ko Hibernate track nahi karta. merge() se managed copy lo, ya entity ko transaction ke andar fetch karo.

1310 lakh records insert karne hain

Batch mein karo: har 100 par flush() aur clear(), warna OutOfMemoryError. IDENTITY batching disable karta hai.

14Checked exception aaya par data save ho gaya

Default mein checked exception par rollback nahi hota. rollbackFor = Exception.class lagao.

15Department delete karne par foreign key error

Students (children) maujood hain. Pehle children hatao ya parent-child relation par CascadeType.REMOVE / orphanRemoval lagao.

16Page aur Slice mein kab kya?

Total count chahiye to Page (2 queries). Infinite scroll mein Slice (1 query).

17mappedBy kis side par lagta hai?

Inverse side par, jiski table mein FK nahi hai. Owning side @JoinColumn ke saath FK rakhti hai.

18Raw JDBC aur JdbcTemplate mein kya farak hai?

Raw JDBC mein connection, statement, close aur exception har baar khud. JdbcTemplate mein fixed flow Spring ka, tum sirf SQL, parameters aur RowMapper dete ho: Template pattern.

19Requests 'Connection is not available, request timed out' de rahi hain

Hikari pool khaali hai: kahin connection close nahi ho raha ya transactions bahut lambi hain. Leak dhoondo, pool size aankh band karke mat badhao.

20Postman se POST /api/students bheja, par response 500 aur 'getReader() has already been called'. Kya hua?

Kisi filter ne request body getReader()/getInputStream() se padh li, stream consume ho gayi aur Jackson ko khaali mila. ContentCachingRequestWrapper ya custom wrapper use karo. Dekho Q90.

21Filter mein chain.doFilter() ke baad X-Request-ID header set kiya, client ko nahi mila. Kyun?

Response commit ho chuka tha. Header chain.doFilter() se pehle set karo. Dekho Q86.

22Unauthorized request bhi logging filter mein log ho rahi hai. Kya badlein?

AuthenticationFilter ko @Order(1) aur LoggingFilter ko @Order(2) do, taaki auth pehle short-circuit kare. Dekho Q88.

23Controller ka naam log karna hai har request ke saath. Filter ya Interceptor?

Interceptor: preHandle mein handler ko HandlerMethod mein cast karke getBeanType() aur getMethod() lo. Dekho Q95.

24Dev mein real SMS nahi jaana chahiye, prod mein jaana chahiye. Kaise?

Interface ke do implementations, ek @Profile("prod") aur ek @Profile({"dev","default","staging"}). Dekho Q48.

25@Around advice lagayi aur ab controller ko null mil raha hai. Galti?

Advice ne pjp.proceed() ka result return nahi kiya (ya void return type rakha). Result lautao. Dekho Q107.

26@AfterThrowing se exception pakad kar default value lautani hai. Ho payega?

Nahi, @AfterThrowing exception rok nahi sakta. Iske liye @Around mein try-catch use karo. Dekho Q105.

27Same service ke andar se @TrackExecutionTime wala method call kiya, time print nahi hua. Kyun?

Self-invocation: this se call proxy ko bypass karta hai. Method alag bean mein le jao. Dekho Q114.

28Custom annotation bana kar method par lagayi, aspect chal hi nahi raha, koi error bhi nahi. Pehla shak?

@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME) missing hai, ya aspect par @Component nahi hai. Dekho Q116.

29execution(* *(..)) lagate hi app start nahi ho rahi. Kyun?

Spring internal beans ko bhi proxy karne ki koshish karta hai aur BeanCreationException aata hai. Pointcut ko base package tak seemit karo. Dekho Q109.
